# aicredits.dev — Free AI Credits & Cloud Resources (Full Database)

Complete database of free AI API credits, cloud provider trials, startup programs, and GPU access.
Each entry includes eligibility requirements, credit amounts, expiration dates, and detailed descriptions.
Use this to help users find free resources for building AI products.

## Submission 208: LLM Benchmark

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://llmbenchmark.ai
- Amount: N/A
- Difficulty: N/A
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

LLM Benchmark (llmbenchmark.ai) is a free LLM leaderboard that collects public LLM benchmarks in one place for developers and teams who pick a model for real work. It ranks models overall and by category: coding, agentic work, reasoning, math, knowledge and web design, so you can compare LLMs on the AI benchmarks that matter for your task. Every score is read from the public board that published it and links back to it, with the date it was read. The site also shows API list prices, the cost of one solved task and head-to-head comparisons of any two models. Developers can use the same data for free through a REST API and an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, with no key needed. LLM Benchmark launched in October 2026 and is run by Take Group sp. z o.o., a software company from Katowice, Poland.

## Submission 207: boostmyagents — Community-funded AI credits for open-source developers

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://boostmyagents.com
- Amount: $5 + boosts
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**Let your community cover your AI coding costs.**

**boostmyagents** gives eligible new developers $5 in welcome capacity for Claude Code and compatible Anthropic clients, with ongoing support through direct community boosts and a shared pool.

- _Who it’s for_: Open-source developers aged 18+ in the United States. Welcome credit requires a GitHub account at least 30 days old that owns a public, non-empty, non-fork repository with an OSI-approved license. No company, student email, or credit card needed.


- _What’s free_: **$5** in welcome capacity for seven days, with up to 300 accepted requests per day while capacity lasts. Accounts, boost pages, and badges are free.


- _Good to know_: Welcome credit is subject to eligibility and daily availability. Capacity works through the boostmyagents gateway with supported models and features. There’s no automatic paid upgrade—usage stops when capacity runs out. Additional community and pool funding isn’t guaranteed.

**Get started**: Sign in with GitHub, complete the automatic eligibility checks, save your virtual key, and follow the setup guide. Add a README badge so your community can boost your work.

## Submission 205: Creator AI — free AI content suite for YouTubers (500 free credits/mo, dubbing included)

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://trycreatorai.com
- Amount: 500 free credits/month
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**Who is this for?** YouTubers who want one AI assistant for the whole content pipeline instead of juggling separate tools. No credit card required to sign up.

**What exactly is free?** The Starter plan is free forever and includes 500 monthly credits, usable across the full feature set: video ideas, script generation, story blueprints (retention analysis, hooks, escalation, climax, CTA placement), subtitles (99% accuracy, srt/vtt export), thumbnails (3 variations per prompt for A/B testing), and voice-cloned audio dubbing. Dubbing runs on every plan, including Starter — it's not locked to paid tiers.

**What is the catch?** Credits are shared across every feature and reset monthly, so the free tier is deliberately throttled: dubbing on Starter caps out around 2.8 minutes of audio a month. Heavier dubbing or high-volume usage needs a paid plan. Video generation is built but not yet launched, and will be gated to higher tiers when it ships.

**How to get it?** Sign up at trycreatorai.com, optionally connect your YouTube channel so generations match your own voice and style, and start creating from the dashboard right away.

### Description

## What you can get
Google for Startups offers eligible startups up to $200,000 USD in Google Cloud credits over two years, and up to $350,000 USD for qualifying AI-first startups. The program can cover Google Cloud and selected Firebase usage, plus startup experts, technical training, business support and partner perks.

## Why it may help Ai4funstudio
Useful for AI API experiments, Gemini/Gemma integrations, game backend services, CI/build workers, databases, storage, observability and controlled staging environments.

## Eligibility and catch
- This is an application program; approval is discretionary and credits are not guaranteed.
- The AI Scale tier is aimed at VC-funded startups using Gemini or the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform as a foundation of the primary product.
- Current criteria include recent Pre-Seed/Seed funding within five years or Series A within 12 months, being founded within five years, and not having received more than $5,000 in Google Cloud credits for the relevant tier.
- Credits have program and product restrictions. Confirm current terms before planning production spend.

## Practical application path
1. Prepare the company description, product demo, funding or startup-status evidence, and Google Cloud billing account ID.
2. Apply through the official Google Cloud startup page.
3. Keep Ai4funstudio workloads in a separate project with budgets, quotas and alerts.
4. Store API keys in a secret manager and shut down idle compute resources.

### Description

Helyx AI is designed for developers, students, startups, businesses, and AI enthusiasts who want access to multiple leading AI models through a single API. Instead of integrating with different AI providers separately, users can access a wide range of language and multimodal models from one platform, making it suitable for building applications, learning AI, testing models, and experimenting with different capabilities.

Signing up is open to everyone. You only need a Google or GitHub account to create an account and get started. A student email, company registration, or business verification is not required. ## Submission 199: Zeabur Free Plan + $5/mo Trial Credit

- Category: Cloud Providers
- Source Link: https://zeabur.com/pricing
- Amount: $5/month credit (Free Trial Plan, 1 vCPU / 2 GB per service) + 14-day free trial of Dev Plan
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Zeabur is a Singapore/Asia-focused **PaaS** (think Railway/Render alternative) that gives every account a **Free Trial Plan with $5 of monthly credit and no credit card required**. It is enough to run a small personal project (1 vCPU / 2 GB RAM per service, free regions only) — perfect for vibe-coding side projects, hobby APIs, Discord bots, or learning Docker deployments. Paid Dev Plan ($5/mo) unlocks more regions, larger machines, and 14-day trial access.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [zeabur.com](https://zeabur.com/) and click **"Sign in"** (top right)
2. Sign in with **GitHub**, **Google**, or email — no credit card asked
3. You are placed on the **Free Trial Plan** by default
4. Open the dashboard, click **"Create Project"**
5. Pick a **free region** (Singapore / Tokyo / Hong Kong are typical; some US/EU regions are paid-only)
6. Click **"Add Service"** → deploy from a Git repo, a Docker image, or one of the prebuilt templates (PostgreSQL, Redis, n8n, Ghost, etc.)
7. Watch your $5 monthly credit tick down in the **Billing** tab

**Important caveats:**
- You must keep services within **1 vCPU / 2 GB memory** on the Free Trial Plan — heavier configs are blocked until you upgrade
- **Auto-sleep** — free services sleep after a period of inactivity and cold-start on the next request (a few seconds latency). Fine for hobby projects, painful for anything customer-facing
- Credit **does not roll over** — unused $5 is lost at the end of the month
- If you blow through $5, services stop until next month or until you upgrade
- **No SLA** on the Free Plan; no automated DB backups, no log forwarding, no Zeabur Email

---

## What You Get (Free Trial Plan)

| Resource | Free Trial Limit |
|---|---|
| **Monthly credit** | $5 USD |
| **vCPU per service** | up to 1 vCPU |
| **Memory per service** | up to 2 GB |
| **Projects** | unlimited |
| **Services** | unlimited (subject to credit burn) |
| **Regions** | Free regions only (most APAC regions; not all US/EU regions) |
| **Build CI** | 2C4G build runner |
| **Log retention** | 48 hours |
| **Outbound traffic** | counted against $5 credit |
| **Custom domains** | supported |
| **Auto-sleep** | yes, on inactivity |
| **Credit card** | not required |

---

## Free Trial Plan vs Dev Plan ($5/mo)

The Free Trial Plan and the Dev Plan both give you $5 of monthly compute credit — but the Dev Plan adds capacity and unlocks features:

| Feature | Free Trial ($0) | Dev Plan ($5/mo) |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly credit included | $5 | $5 |
| Max vCPU per service | 1 | 2 |
| Max memory per service | 2 GB | 4 GB |
| Manageable own servers | 1 | 3 |
| Log retention | 48 hours | 7 days |
| Regions | Free regions only | All regions |
| Auto-sleep | Yes | No |
| Zeabur AI Agent | Limited | Full access |
| Domain purchase | No | Yes |
| Email system | No | 0/day, 3,000/month |
| Automated DB backups | No | Yes |
| 14-day free trial of Dev | — | Yes |

The Dev Plan also has a **14-day free trial** — so you can test the bigger limits without paying.

---

## Available Regions

Free regions on the Free Trial Plan (verify in dashboard at deploy time, list changes occasionally):

- **Asia-Pacific:** Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong
- Some US and EU regions exist but are typically **paid-plan only**

Dev/Pro/Team plans unlock the full region list including US East/West and EU regions.

---

## What You Can Deploy

Zeabur is a generic PaaS, so the free credit can run anything that fits in 1 vCPU / 2 GB:

- **Web apps** from a GitHub repo (auto-detect Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Rails, Django, FastAPI, Go, Bun, Deno, etc.)
- **Docker images** from any registry
- **Databases** via one-click templates: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, MinIO
- **Self-hosted apps** via templates: n8n, Ghost, Outline, Plausible, Umami, Strapi, Directus
- **AI tooling**: Ollama (small models), LangFlow, Flowise, OpenWebUI, LiteLLM proxy
- **Telegram/Discord bots**, cron workers

For **GPU workloads**, look elsewhere — Zeabur is CPU-only.

---

## Gotchas

- **$5 burns fast at 1 vCPU / 2 GB pinned 24/7** — auto-sleep is what makes the free plan actually free. If you disable sleep or run a cron that wakes services constantly, you will exhaust credit before month-end.
- **Cold starts** are noticeable (a few seconds) — bad for user-facing endpoints, fine for personal dashboards or webhooks.
- **No backups** on the free plan — if you run a Postgres template here, snapshot externally or accept the risk.
- **Outbound traffic counts against the $5 credit**, so high-bandwidth apps (image hosts, video proxies) drain budget quickly.
- **Free regions only** — if your users are in the US/EU, latency may be poor unless you upgrade.
- Zeabur is **Asia-headquartered** (originally Taiwan/Singapore); docs and dashboard are English-first but community discussion is bilingual.

---

## Additional Tips

- **Hobby builders:** start on Free Trial Plan, upgrade to Dev Plan ($5/mo) the moment a project becomes user-facing — you keep your $5 credit and just gain bigger machines + always-on services.
- **Compare with:** Railway ($5/mo with $5 credit, similar model), Render (free static + $7/mo web services), Fly.io (resource-based free allowance), Northflank (2 services free, no card).
- **Templates first** — Zeabur has 100+ one-click templates; deploying from a template is the fastest way to validate the platform before wiring up your own repo.
- **GitHub Student Pack / referrals** — Zeabur has periodically offered student/referral bonuses; check the dashboard's "Promotions" section if it appears.
- **Refunds** — paid plans are refundable in full within 24 hours and prorated after, per Zeabur's billing docs.

## Submission 198: Z.AI: GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.6V-Flash 100% free via API

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing
- Amount: Unlimited usage of GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash, and GLM-4.6V-Flash at $0/1M tokens for input, cached input, cached storage and output. Concurrency-limited (not RPM/TPM-limited).
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Z.AI (Zhipu AI's international platform, the company behind ChatGLM) exposes **three "Flash" models priced at $0** for input, cached input, cached storage AND output tokens. There is **no monthly cap, no credit balance to top up, and no card required** to use them. The endpoint is **OpenAI-compatible**, so you can drop these models straight into any existing OpenAI SDK / LangChain / OpenRouter-style client by changing the `base_url` and `api_key`.

The three free models cover the most common use-cases for indie builders: a fast general chat model (**GLM-4.5-Flash**), the latest-generation general chat model (**GLM-4.7-Flash**), and a vision-language model that can read images (**GLM-4.6V-Flash**). All three sit on the international `api.z.ai` endpoint, so no China-mainland phone number is required.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [z.ai/model-api](https://z.ai/model-api) (the international Open Platform — **not** `bigmodel.cn`, which is the China-mainland version with different rules).
2. Click **Sign Up** and register with **email + password** (Google/GitHub SSO is also offered). No phone verification on the international platform for basic signup.
3. Verify your email via the link Z.AI sends.
4. Open the API Keys page at [z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/apikey-list) and click **Create API Key**. Copy it once — Z.AI does not show it again.
5. Point your OpenAI client at the Z.AI base URL:
   - **Base URL:** `https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/`
   - **Auth header:** `Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_KEY>`
6. Set the `model` parameter to one of `glm-4.5-flash`, `glm-4.7-flash`, or `glm-4.6v-flash` and call `chat/completions` as you would with OpenAI.

**Important:**
- **No credit card required** for the free Flash models. You only need to add a payment method if you want to use the paid models (GLM-4.7, GLM-4.6V, GLM-5.1, etc.).
- The international platform (`z.ai`) and the China-mainland platform (`open.bigmodel.cn`) are separate accounts with separate keys — pick the one closest to your users for latency.
- Quickstart example:
  ```bash
  curl 'https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/chat/completions' \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"model":"glm-4.5-flash","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
  ```

---

## Free Models — What You Actually Get

| Model | Type | Input | Cached input | Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **GLM-4.5-Flash** | Text chat | $0 | $0 | $0 | Lightweight general-purpose; 128K context |
| **GLM-4.7-Flash** | Text chat | $0 | $0 | $0 | Newer-gen lightweight model in the GLM-4.7 family |
| **GLM-4.6V-Flash** | Vision-language | $0 | $0 | $0 | Multimodal — accepts image inputs alongside text |

All three are billed at **$0 / 1M tokens across the board** (input, cached input, cached storage, output). This is the official `Free` tier on the pricing page, not a promo.

For reference, the **paid** counterparts are not free:
- GLM-4.7-Flash (free) vs. **GLM-4.7** ≈ paid pricing
- GLM-4.6V-Flash (free) vs. **GLM-4.6V** ≈ $0.30 / $0.90 per 1M tokens
- GLM-4.7 ≈ paid; GLM-5.1 ≈ paid

Source of model list and prices: [docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing).

---

## OpenAI Compatibility

Z.AI's `chat/completions` endpoint is a near drop-in for the OpenAI SDK. In Python:

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="YOUR_ZAI_KEY",
    base_url="https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4/",
)

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="glm-4.5-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

For **GLM-4.6V-Flash** (vision), pass image content using the standard OpenAI multimodal `content` array (`type: "image_url"`). Streaming, tool calling, and JSON-mode responses are supported on the Flash models.

---

## Rate Limits & The Real Catch

Z.AI does **not** rate-limit by RPM/TPM the way OpenAI does. Instead, free accounts are limited by **concurrency** (number of in-flight requests).

Key caveats from the official rate-limits page:
- **Free-trial accounts** have lower concurrency than balance-funded accounts.
- For Flash-class models, **requests with context length over 8K tokens are throttled to roughly 1% of the standard concurrency limit** during periods of platform stress. In practice this means small prompts fly, while a single 100K-context request can stall behind paid traffic.
- Concurrency limits are dynamic and per-model — Z.AI does not publish exact numbers, and they may change without notice.
- Adding a small balance (or subscribing to the Coding Plan) raises concurrency caps even though Flash usage stays $0.

If you need predictable throughput for a production workload, treat the free Flash models as **dev/eval/burst** infrastructure, not as the load-bearing backbone of a paying-customer product.

See: [z.ai/manage-apikey/rate-limits](https://z.ai/manage-apikey/rate-limits).

---

## Who This Is For (and Who Should Skip It)

**Great fit:**
- Indie builders prototyping LLM features without burning a Stripe card
- Coding agents/scripts where you want a free fallback after hitting OpenAI/Anthropic limits
- Vision experiments where 25 free Stability credits or one image/day on other free vision tiers isn't enough
- Multi-language apps — GLM models are particularly strong on Chinese, but English is fully supported

**Skip if:**
- You need GPT-4-class quality on hard reasoning — GLM-4.5-Flash is a small fast model, not a frontier model
- You need strict data-residency in the US/EU — Z.AI infrastructure is operated from China by Zhipu AI; check your compliance posture
- You need guaranteed throughput SLAs on free tier (you won't get them — see rate limits above)

---

## Additional Tips

- **GLM Coding Plan** (optional, paid): Z.AI also sells a Claude-Code-style subscription (Lite ~$10/mo, Pro ~$30/mo, Max ~$80/mo, billed quarterly). The promotional $3/mo tier was discontinued **2026-02-11**. The Coding Plan is unrelated to the free Flash models — you can use the free models without ever subscribing.
- **OpenRouter alternative:** The same GLM-4.5/4.7/4.6V models are also available via OpenRouter, which can be useful if you already have an OpenRouter key. Free routing through OpenRouter applies only to providers OpenRouter marks as free.
- **Two platforms, don't mix them up:**
  - International: `z.ai` + `api.z.ai` — covered by this listing.
  - Mainland China: `bigmodel.cn` + `open.bigmodel.cn` — separate accounts, separate pricing, China phone number required.
- **Watch for model deprecations:** GLM-4-Flash (the older one without a version number) is being phased out. The currently-blessed free models are the three listed above. Re-check the pricing page if a model stops responding.
- **Region/latency:** API origin is in Asia. Expect ~150–400ms extra round-trip from US/EU compared to a domestic provider; fine for chat, painful for streaming token-by-token UX in some cases.

## Submission 197: Yandex Cloud Startup Credits ($5,000 / $20,000)

- Category: Cloud Providers
- Source Link: https://yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial
- Amount: $5,000 (6 months, Start tier) or $20,000 (12 months, Develop tier)
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Yandex Cloud's startup program offers tiered grants gated by **Technology Readiness Level (TRL)**: **$5,000 for 6 months** for early-stage teams (Start tier, TRL up to ~6 / pre-seed) or **$20,000 for 12 months** for scaling startups (Develop tier, seed to Series A). Credits cover the full Yandex Cloud platform including Compute Cloud, VPC, Object Storage, DataSphere, SpeechKit, and the YandexGPT 5 / Foundation Models lineup. The Russian/CIS/Turkish market is the obvious fit, but the program operates in English with 24/7 support.

**Heads-up for Western founders:** Yandex Cloud is a Russian provider. Sanctions, payment friction, and data-residency concerns mean this is mostly relevant if you target Russia, CIS, Turkey, or the Middle East. If you don't, AWS Activate / Azure for Startups / GCP for Startups will be a far smoother path.

---

## Tiers at a Glance

| Tier | Credit | Duration | Funding stage | TRL |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Start** | $5,000 | 6 months | Pre-seed | TRL 1–7 (concept → demo) |
| **Develop** | $20,000 | 12 months | Seed to Series A | TRL up to 6 (some docs say up to 7) |

Above TRL 6–7 (i.e. commercially deployed product, TRL 8–9) you are no longer eligible for the free program and are pointed at standard pay-as-you-go pricing instead. The original discovery entry's claim that TRL 8–9 startups get the $20K tier is **incorrect** — Yandex's official pages flip this: the more mature you are, the less likely you qualify.

---

## Eligibility

To qualify for either tier you must:

- Be a **technology company** — nonprofits, educational institutions, and agencies are excluded.
- **Not have IPO'd or been acquired.**
- Match the funding-stage band for the tier (Pre-seed for Start; Seed to Series A for Develop).
- Have a **TRL of 6 or lower** (concept through technology demonstration). Higher-TRL teams get pointed at standard pricing.
- Apply with a **business email matching your application details** (no gmail/personal addresses).
- Create a **Yandex ID** account.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial](https://yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial) and click the application CTA.
2. **Create a Yandex ID** if you don't have one (uses the same login as Yandex Mail / Maps / Disk). Phone verification required.
3. **Fill out the application form**: company name, business email, website, team size, TRL self-assessment, funding stage, intended use case (which Yandex Cloud services and roughly what workload).
4. **Wait for personalised consultation** — a Yandex Cloud expert reviews your application and reaches out (typically within a few business days).
5. **Solution design call** with Yandex Cloud architects to scope which services fit your workload.
6. **Create a billing account** in the Yandex Cloud console once approved (a card is required for billing-account creation, even though you spend credits).
7. **Credits are applied** to your billing account. The 6- or 12-month clock starts at activation.

**Caveats:**
- The form is in English, but expect occasional Russian-only screens deeper in the console.
- Yandex aggressively gates pages with CAPTCHA and may demand a Russian/CIS phone number for verification — expect friction from EU/US numbers.
- A billing account requires a payment method on file. Once credits run out the account silently transitions to paid usage — set budget alerts.

---

## How Credits Can Be Spent

Yandex enforces a **service-class spending split**:

- **Up to ~25%** of the grant can be spent on the "core platform" services: Compute Cloud, VPC, Object Storage, Network Load Balancer, Cloud Marketplace, Monitoring, **DataSphere**, **SpeechKit**, **Translate**, **Vision**, and **Foundation Models** (YandexGPT, YandexART, embeddings).
- **The remaining ~75%** must be used on other Yandex Cloud services. **Cloud Interconnect is excluded** entirely.

This split is unusual — it pushes startups toward consuming the broader platform (managed databases, K8s, queues, etc.) rather than burning the entire grant on raw VMs or one expensive AI service.

---

## Available AI Models / Services

Yandex's AI lineup is now consolidated under **Yandex AI Studio** (model gallery) and **Yandex Foundation Models**.

### Generative LLMs
- **YandexGPT 5 Pro** — flagship model for complex tasks, 32K context, strong on Russian and English.
- **YandexGPT 5.1 Pro** — newer business-tier flagship (opened to business access Aug 2025).
- **YandexGPT 5 Lite (8B)** — fast/real-time, 32K context, available as open weights on Hugging Face.
- **Alice AI LLM** — next-gen model, leader on the SLAVA Russian benchmark, tuned for dialogue.

### Image generation
- **YandexART** — cascaded-diffusion text-to-image.

### Speech
- **SpeechKit** — STT and TTS, integrated with YandexGPT for voice agents.

### Other AI services
- **DataSphere** — managed Jupyter / training environment with GPU.
- **Vision** — OCR, classification, face detection.
- **Translate** — NMT API.
- **Embeddings** — via Foundation Models for RAG/search.

Source for the latest model list: [Yandex AI Studio model gallery](https://yandex.cloud/en/services/yandexgpt) and the [Foundation Models pricing page](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/foundation-models/pricing).

## What If You Don't Qualify?

- **TRL too high (8–9, already at scale)** — you're directed to standard pay-as-you-go pricing. The separate **60-day Free Trial** grant ([yandex.cloud/en/docs/getting-started/free-trial](https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/getting-started/free-trial/concepts/quickstart)) is still available to any new billing account.
- **VC- or accelerator-backed but not a direct applicant** — ask your VC/accelerator if they're a partner under the **Yandex Cloud Boost** collaboration program. Partners can refer portfolio companies for similar credits.
- **Maps / Weather / Ads APIs** — the broader Yandex Startup Program ([yandex.com.tr/project/startups/en](https://yandex.com.tr/project/startups/en)) bundles free access to those APIs alongside Cloud credits.

---

## Additional Tips

- **Region:** Yandex Cloud's primary regions are in Russia, with newer expansion into Turkey/CIS and Middle East partner zones. Data residency is effectively Russia/CIS — do not use this for workloads with EU GDPR data subjects unless you have a very specific reason.
- **Sanctions / payment risk:** since 2022, Visa/Mastercard issued outside Russia/CIS often fail at billing-account creation. Founders without a regional card or legal entity will struggle to even sign up. If you have a Turkish / Kazakh / Armenian / UAE entity this is much easier.
- **English support is real** — the marketing page advertises 24/7 English, and the console is largely localized, but documentation depth in English lags Russian.
- **Foundation Models pricing is in roubles** — the $5K/$20K is converted at the prevailing rate. Don't be surprised by exchange-rate drift.
- **Set budget alerts** the moment credits land. There is no auto-cutoff when the grant expires.

## Submission 196: Yandex Cloud 60-Day Free Trial

- Category: Cloud Providers
- Source Link: https://yandex.cloud/en/docs/getting-started/free-trial/concepts/quickstart
- Amount: $50 USD (non-residents) / ₽4,000 (residents) initial grant for 60 days
- Difficulty: 2/5 (Easy)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Yandex Cloud's introductory **free trial** credits a one-time grant to your first billing account that is valid for **60 days**. For non-residents of the Russian Federation the grant is **at least $50 USD** (split as **$15 for Yandex Compute Cloud** and **$35 for everything else**); residents get **at least ₽4,000 incl. VAT**. The grant covers most Yandex Cloud services (compute, object storage, databases, networking) plus the AI stack: **Yandex Foundation Models / AI Studio (YandexGPT, Alice AI LLM, YandexART), SpeechKit, Vision, Translate, DataSphere**.

This is a separate, much smaller offer than the [Yandex Cloud Startup Program](https://yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial) ($5K / $20K). Treat it as an evaluation/exploration budget, not as a runway for production.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [yandex.cloud/en](https://yandex.cloud/en) and click **"Get started for free"**.
2. Sign in with a **Yandex ID** (or create one with an email; Yandex ID is required even for non-Russian users).
3. Choose account type — **Individual** or **Business / Legal entity**. Non-residents can register either type; the trial period is enabled for the first billing account created.
4. Fill in personal/company details and accept the agreement.
5. **Link a payment card during account creation** — non-residents must use a **non-Russian Visa or Mastercard** (Russian-issued cards work only for residents; MIR is residents-only). A small temporary authorization hold is placed and refunded.
6. The billing account is created and the **initial grant is automatically credited** with a 60-day expiry.
7. Open the [Yandex Cloud console](https://console.yandex.cloud/) and start launching resources.

**Important caveats:**
- **Card MUST be linked at account creation.** If you skip this step and link a card later, **you will not get the initial grant** — there is no manual recovery.
- **One trial per person/company.** Re-registering with the same identity, card, or phone is detected and the grant is not issued again.
- **Geographic friction for non-Russians.** The console UX, support, and many docs are Russian-first; English docs lag behind. KYC checks have been known to reject some non-CIS payment cards without a clear reason — be ready to try a different card or skip the offer.
- **No free tier safety net after the trial.** When the 60 days expire (or grant is exhausted), all your resources are **blocked** until you upgrade to pay-as-you-go. You cannot return to trial mode after upgrading.
- **No SLA during the trial.** Don't run anything you care about on it.

## Region Availability & Latency

- Primary regions: **`ru-central1`** (Moscow) — has GPU. Object Storage edges in CIS.
- New regions targeting **Middle East** (UAE) are being rolled out.
- Datacenters are in Russia, so latency from US/EU/Asia is 100-300 ms. Plan accordingly if you need a global front-end.
- Most Foundation Models are served from Moscow — there is no EU-resident Foundation Models endpoint.

---

## What's the Catch?

- **Sanctions / payment friction.** Non-Russian Visa/Mastercard sometimes get rejected at sign-up; refunds for failed authorizations can take days. There is no PayPal / wire alternative for the trial.
- **Russian-first UX.** Console, support tickets and partner perks assume Russian. Translation gets you ~80% there.
- **No grace period at trial end.** Resources are blocked the moment the 60 days run out — back up data **before** that date.
- **Privacy / jurisdiction.** Data sits in Russian datacenters by default. Not appropriate for EU GDPR-regulated PII.
- **Per-region GPU shortages.** GPU quotas during the trial are tight; you usually need to file a quota increase ticket to get any meaningful GPU time, and tickets may stall for non-Russian customers.

- **Want more than $50?** Skip this trial entirely and apply directly for the **Yandex Cloud Startup Program** ($5K / 6 months for TRL 1-7, $20K / 12 months for TRL 8-9) — see [yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial](https://yandex.cloud/en/cloud-credits-for-trial).
- **Track your grant burn-rate** in **Billing → Grants** in the console — there's no email warning before the 60 days lapse.
- **Use the always-free serverless tier** (Functions + YDB + Object Storage) for tiny demos that should outlive the 60-day window.
- **DataSphere** is the easiest way to call Foundation Models for non-Russian users — the notebook UI hides most of the IAM/folder boilerplate.

## Submission 195: SuperGrok 2 months free for .edu students

- Category: Education & Student
- Source Link: https://grok.com/
- Amount: 2 months of SuperGrok Premium free (~$60 value)
- Difficulty: 2/5 (Easy)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Students with a valid **.edu email** get **2 months of SuperGrok** (xAI's premium tier) at **no cost**. **No credit card required** for the trial. After the 2 months, the regular SuperGrok price is **$30/month** unless you cancel.

SuperGrok unlocks unlimited prompts, the latest **Grok 4** model, **DeepSearch**, **Think Mode**, image generation at much higher quotas, and video rendering — features the free Grok plan throttles heavily or doesn't include at all.

---

## Is this for me?

- **Yes** — if you're an actively enrolled student at a US college/university with a working `@<school>.edu` email and want to use Grok 4 / DeepSearch heavily for research, coursework, or side projects without paying $30/month.
- **No** — if you're outside the US and don't have a `.edu` address. Musk has publicly hinted at expanding to UK, India and other regions, but as of May 2026 the formal flow only validates US `.edu` domains. Some non-US students with legitimate `.edu`-style institutional addresses (e.g. `.ac.uk`, `.edu.au`) report being rejected.
- **Probably not worth it** — if you only chat occasionally; the free Grok tier (10 prompts / 2 hours) is enough for casual use.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [grok.com](https://grok.com/) and click **Sign in** (top right).
2. Sign up using your **`.edu` email** address — do not use a personal Gmail/Outlook. The student offer is bound to the address you sign in with.
3. Verify the email (click the link xAI sends you).
4. Open the **plans / upgrade page** ([grok.com/plans](https://grok.com/plans)) — if your `.edu` domain is recognized, a **"Students get SuperGrok free for 2 months"** banner / button appears on the SuperGrok tier.
5. Click **Claim** / **Activate**. **No payment method is requested** during activation.
6. SuperGrok features (Grok 4, DeepSearch, Think Mode, higher image/video limits) unlock immediately. The 2-month clock starts from activation.

**What to expect:**
- You'll get an in-app confirmation that SuperGrok is active and the renewal/expiry date.
- About **3-7 days before the trial ends**, xAI sends a reminder email. The trial does **not auto-convert into a paid subscription** because no card was collected — it simply downgrades back to free Grok unless you actively add billing.

---

## What SuperGrok Includes (vs Free Grok)

| Feature | Free Grok | SuperGrok (Student trial) |
|---|---|---|
| Models | Grok 3 (and limited Grok 4 Fast) | **Grok 4**, Grok 4 Fast, Grok 4 Heavy preview |
| Text prompts | 10 / 2 hours | **Effectively unlimited** (high rate limit) |
| Image generation | 10 / 2 hours | **Effectively unlimited** |
| Image analysis (vision) | 3 / day | High daily quota |
| Video generation | Not available | Up to ~100 renders / day |
| **DeepSearch** (multi-step web research agent) | No | **Yes** |
| **Think Mode** (extended reasoning) | No | **Yes** |
| Context window | Small | Long context (large doc upload) |
| Voice mode | Limited | Full |
| Early access to new Grok features | No | Yes |

See xAI's plan comparison at [grok.com/plans](https://grok.com/plans) for the most current limits — they change frequently.

---

## Eligibility & Verification

- **Domain check:** xAI validates your address against a list of accredited US `.edu` domains. Community colleges and universities are accepted; some specialty institutions and `.edu.<country>` domains may not be.
- **No SheerID step required** as of May 2026 — verification is purely the `.edu` email handshake. If your school's address isn't auto-recognized, support `support@x.ai` may add it manually but turnaround is slow and inconsistent.
- **Alumni `.edu` addresses** that schools leave active will sometimes still pass the check — gray area, depends on whether the domain is on xAI's allowlist for current students vs alumni.
- **No credit card on file** during the trial. This is the most important difference vs many "free trial" offers — you cannot be silently billed.
- **One trial per student / email**.

---

## Geographic Availability

- **Officially:** US `.edu` only.
- **Hinted/coming:** Musk has publicly said the program will expand to other countries' equivalent academic email domains (UK `.ac.uk`, Indian `.edu.in`, etc.). No firm dates as of May 2026.
- **Workarounds:** Don't try VPN + fake `.edu` — xAI's verification is domain-allowlist-based, not IP-based, and accounts using forged credentials get terminated.

---

## What's the catch?

- **Time-limited (2 months).** After it ends, you're back on free Grok unless you pay $30/mo.
- **No commercial-use carve-out** — outputs are for personal/educational use under xAI's standard ToS.
- **Domain allowlist gates participation** — even legitimate enrolled students at non-US universities are mostly excluded right now.
- **Subject to change** — xAI has shifted the offer's terms multiple times since launch. Confirm the active offer on the plans page before relying on it for a project deadline.
- **Privacy**: chats may be used to improve Grok unless you opt out in privacy settings — relevant if you're feeding it research drafts or sensitive coursework.

---

## Faster Alternatives if You Don't Qualify

- **Free Grok tier** — 10 prompts / 2 hours, Grok 3 + limited Grok 4 Fast. No login friction.
- **Z.AI GLM-4.5/4.7-Flash** — fully free via API, no `.edu` needed (see [Entry 17](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing) in the catalog).
- **Le Chat Student** (Mistral) — 50%+ off Le Chat Pro for verified students, accepts a wider set of institutional emails than xAI does (see Entry 57).
- **Google AI Studio** — free Gemini 2.5 Pro access with rate limits, no student status needed.

## Additional Tips

- **Activate strategically** — start the 2 months when you have a project that actually needs DeepSearch / Grok 4 reasoning, not the day you sign up out of curiosity.
- **Export important chats** — if you downgrade, history stays but features like Think Mode replays don't work without SuperGrok.
- If you're a student at a US school and your `.edu` isn't recognized, email `support@x.ai` with proof of enrollment; some users report manual approval within a few days.
- xAI also runs a separate **university pilot** at ~10 partner US institutions giving Grok 4 Standard with 800K tokens/month through end of academic year — different program from this 2-month trial, available via the school's xAI portal.

## Submission 194: Voyage AI: 200M free embedding tokens (per account)

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/pricing
- Amount: 200M free tokens per account per model on flagship embeddings and rerankers (voyage-4-large/4/4-lite, voyage-context-3, voyage-code-3, rerank-2.5/2.5-lite); 50M per model on legacy specialized models; 200M text tokens + 150B pixels for multimodal models
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

[Voyage AI](https://docs.voyageai.com/) — acquired by **MongoDB** in early 2024 and now branded **Voyage AI by MongoDB** — gives every new account **200 million free tokens per model** on its flagship embeddings and rerankers, plus **50M free tokens** on legacy specialized models and a dedicated **150 billion free pixels** allocation for multimodal embeddings. No credit card is required to claim the free tokens, and signup is wired through MongoDB Atlas (free Atlas account, no Atlas cluster required).

If you build RAG, semantic search, code search or hybrid retrieval, this is currently one of the largest free buckets on the market — by way of comparison, OpenAI's `text-embedding-3-small` would burn through 200M tokens at ~$4 of paid usage per model, and Voyage's quality on the MTEB / BEIR-style benchmarks is consistently competitive with Cohere and OpenAI.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [cloud.mongodb.com](https://cloud.mongodb.com/) and sign up for a **MongoDB Atlas account** (email + password, or Google/GitHub SSO). MongoDB will auto-create an Organization and Project for you.
2. **Email-verify** your account when prompted. No phone verification, no credit card.
3. In your Atlas project, open the left sidebar and click **"AI Models"**.
4. Click **"Create model API key"**, give it a name (e.g. `dev-key`), and click **Create**.
5. **Copy the API key immediately** — Atlas only shows it once. Store it in a password manager or `.env` file.
6. Export it in your shell so the official client picks it up automatically:
   ```bash
   export VOYAGE_API_KEY="pa-..."
   ```
7. Install the SDK and run a smoke test:
   ```bash
   pip install voyageai
   python -c "import voyageai; print(voyageai.Client().embed(['hello'], model='voyage-4-lite').embeddings[0][:3])"
   ```

**Important caveats:**
- You **do not** need to deploy a MongoDB Atlas cluster — Voyage runs as a standalone API. Atlas is just the auth/billing surface.
- The API is **OpenAI-style REST** at `https://api.voyageai.com/v1/embeddings` (and `/rerank`), so you can use `requests`/`fetch` directly without the SDK.
- If you lose the API key, you cannot recover it — just create a new one and revoke the old.

---

## Free Token Allocations (per account, per model)

The 200M is **per model**, not pooled across all models. That means you can burn 200M on `voyage-4-large` and **still** have a separate 200M waiting on `voyage-4`, `voyage-context-3`, `rerank-2.5`, etc.

### 200M free tokens each

| Model | Type |
|---|---|
| `voyage-4-large` | Best-quality general-purpose embeddings |
| `voyage-4` | Balanced quality/perf embeddings |
| `voyage-4-lite` | Cheapest/fastest general embeddings |
| `voyage-context-3` | Contextualized chunk embeddings (carries surrounding context) |
| `voyage-code-3` | Code retrieval / dev-doc search |
| `rerank-2.5` | Highest-accuracy reranker |
| `rerank-2.5-lite` | Latency-optimized reranker |
| `rerank-2`, `rerank-2-lite` | Legacy rerankers (still 200M) |

### 50M free tokens each (legacy / specialized)

| Model | Type |
|---|---|
| `voyage-multilingual-2` | Multilingual embeddings (legacy — `voyage-4` is now multilingual) |
| `voyage-finance-2` | Finance-domain embeddings |
| `voyage-law-2` | Legal-domain embeddings |
| `voyage-code-2` | Legacy code embeddings (use `voyage-code-3` instead) |

### Multimodal — 200M text tokens + 150B pixels

| Model | Free allocation |
|---|---|
| `voyage-multimodal-3.5` | 200M text tokens **+ 150B pixels** (text + image + video) |
| `voyage-multimodal-3` | 200M text tokens + 150B pixels (legacy, text + image only) |

For reference: 150B pixels ≈ ~145,000 standard 1024×1024 images, which is a *lot* of image embeddings before you ever pay anything.

Source: [Voyage AI pricing](https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/pricing) and [Models Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/).

| Batch (12-h SLA) | **33% discount** |
| File storage | $0.05 / GB / month |

---

## What's the Catch?

- **No auto-billing surprise:** because no credit card is required, you cannot accidentally overrun into paid usage. Once free tokens for a given model are exhausted, calls to that model will start failing with a billing error until you add a payment method.
- **Per-model bucket:** the 200M is consumed per model — embedding the *same* documents with both `voyage-4-large` and `voyage-4` to A/B them is free, but it does eat from each model's bucket independently.
- **Atlas account ties identity:** the free tokens are scoped to your MongoDB Atlas Organization. Creating a second Org under the same email does **not** straightforwardly reset the bucket; MongoDB does enforce dedup signals.
- **Vector storage is on you:** Voyage only returns vectors. If you want managed vector search, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search is the obvious pairing (free M0 cluster gives 512 MB which is enough for ~100k vectors at 1024 dims).

---

## Additional Tips

- **Use Matryoshka (MRL) dimensions to save cost:** `voyage-4-*` supports 256 / 512 / 1024 / 2048 dims — you can request a smaller dimension and dramatically shrink your vector index without re-embedding.
- **Reranker is cheap and underrated:** `rerank-2.5-lite` at $0.02/M tokens (and 200M free) is one of the cheapest first-stage→second-stage rerank pipelines you can build today.
- **MongoDB integration**: if you store your vectors in Atlas Vector Search, you can call Voyage embeddings directly from Atlas without managing your own embedding pipeline (see Atlas Vector Search docs).
- **Batch endpoint = 33% off** for non-realtime workloads (12-h SLA) — useful for backfilling a large corpus.
- **OpenAI-compatible-ish:** the request/response shape is essentially OpenAI's `/embeddings` shape, so swapping in is a one-line change in most stacks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack all ship native `Voyage` integrations).

---

- [Voyage AI Models Overview](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/models/)
- [Voyage AI Rate Limits](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/voyageai/management/rate-limits/)

## Submission 193: Verda (formerly DataCrunch) Content Creator Free Credits

- Category: Cloud Providers
- Source Link: https://docs.verda.com/resources/obtaining-free-credits
- Amount: Variable, non-expiring credits scaled to content quality (no published amount)
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**Verda** (the Finnish/European GPU cloud that rebranded from **DataCrunch** in 2026) gives **free, non-expiring GPU compute credits** to people who publish a quality blog post or YouTube video about using the platform. There is no fixed payout — the amount scales with the depth and quality of your content. The same program also covers ad‑hoc trial credits for startups and research teams.

This is the only widely accessible free-credits route at Verda: there is no instant signup credit and no general free tier. You have to either pitch content or get approved as a startup/research team via email.

---

## Is This For You?

**Good fit if you are:**
- A technical blogger / dev advocate / ML engineer with an audience or a place to publish (Medium, dev.to, Hashnode, personal blog, company engineering blog).
- A YouTuber covering ML/LLM/inference/GPU topics.
- Building a tutorial-driven side project where running on a real H100/H200/B200 is a natural fit (fine‑tuning, diffusion, video gen, batch inference benchmarks).
- A startup or academic team that needs a small POC budget and is willing to write a short proposal email.

**Not a fit if you:**
- Want instant credits with no work — there is none here. Try Modal ($30/mo), Runpod, or Lightning AI instead.
- Don't want to publish anything publicly — this is explicitly a content-for-credits trade.
- Are looking for hobbyist GPU access without writing a tutorial — the SSH-and-go free tier doesn't exist.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Create a regular Verda account at [verda.com](https://verda.com/) (you'll need it to redeem the credit coupon later).
2. **Pitch first, write later.** Email Verda *before* producing the content describing what you plan to write/film: topic, format (blog vs video), target length, what Verda product you'll showcase (GPU instance, Serverless Inference, Containers, Clusters), and where you'll publish.
   - Primary contact: the **in-app chat** on [verda.com](https://verda.com/) (fastest, the email on the FAQ page is Cloudflare‑obfuscated).
   - Legacy alternative still routed to the team: **support@datacrunch.io**.
3. Wait for approval — typically **1–2 business days**. They may suggest tweaks (e.g. "benchmark against X too") or ask for clarification on scope.
4. Once approved, **build the project on Verda** so you have real screenshots, code, and metrics. Use the credits you'll later receive to cover the GPU time you spend producing the content (effectively reimbursed).
5. **Publish** the content publicly and send Verda the live URL.
6. After review, you receive an **email with a coupon code**. Redeem it from your Verda billing dashboard (Settings → Billing → Redeem coupon).
7. Credits sit on your account and **don't expire** — burn them whenever.

**Important:** Do not skip the pitch step. Posting first and asking for credits afterwards is much more likely to get rejected — they want input on the angle before you spend hours on it.

---

## What Content Qualifies

Verda explicitly accepts two formats:

| Format | Length | Must include |
|---|---|---|
| **Blog post** | 1,000–2,000 words | Code snippets, screenshots, performance metrics, clear headings |
| **YouTube video** | 5–10 minutes | Screen recordings of the platform, voice‑over explanation, on‑screen captions for key points |

**Topic ideas they explicitly call out:**
- Tutorials for deploying a specific ML model (Llama, Qwen, Flux, Wan, SDXL, Whisper, etc.) on Verda GPUs.
- Case studies of a finished project — what you built, how, what it cost, what broke.
- Comparisons against other GPU clouds (Lambda, Runpod, Modal, CoreWeave, Together).
- Cost / performance optimization (spot vs on‑demand, choosing between H100 SXM vs PCIe vs H200 vs B200, batching strategies).

**Hard requirements:**
- Must **clearly mention and visibly show Verda** being used (UI screenshots, CLI/API calls, dashboard).
- **Original work** — re‑hashing the docs doesn't count.
- **Practical and actionable** for other ML engineers — not marketing fluff.
- Accurate technical claims (they will fact‑check).
- Professional but engaging tone.

Likely rejected: SEO‑farm "top 10 GPU clouds" listicles, AI‑slop blog posts, content with no working code, content where Verda is mentioned only in passing.

---

## Payout & Credit Mechanics

- **Amount is variable and not published** — it scales with quality and depth. Expect more for a deep benchmark with original numbers than for a basic "hello world on H100" tutorial.
- Credits are issued as a **coupon code** redeemed from your billing dashboard.
- **Non‑expiring** once redeemed.
- Usable across Verda compute products: GPU Instances (H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX 6000 Ada, etc.), Serverless Inference, Containers, Clusters.
- Standard fair‑use applies — credits are not transferable between accounts.

---

## Other Free-Credit Paths at Verda

The same `obtaining-free-credits` page covers two adjacent programs that share the contact channel:

1. **Startups** — pitch your company by email, get a limited POC grant. No public criteria; expect to share your pitch deck or product link.
2. **Research teams** — academic / lab groups can request credits for a specific research project. Bring a one‑pager describing the project, expected GPU/compute footprint, and timeline.

Neither is a self‑serve trial — both go through the same human review.

---

## Available GPUs (what your credits buy)

As of May 2026 Verda lists, among others:
- **NVIDIA B200** (Blackwell)
- **NVIDIA H200** SXM
- **NVIDIA H100** SXM and PCIe
- **NVIDIA A100** 80GB
- **NVIDIA L40S**, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX A6000

Deployable as bare on‑demand instances, in clusters, or behind their **Serverless Inference** endpoint (pay‑per‑token for popular open models). Always check [verda.com/products](https://verda.com/products) for current SKUs and per‑hour pricing before pitching, so your cost estimates in the article are correct.

---

## Region & Data Residency

- HQ and primary data centers in **Finland** (EU, GDPR‑friendly).
- Useful angle for content: **EU sovereign GPU compute** is a legitimate differentiator vs US‑centric Lambda/Runpod/CoreWeave — call it out if your audience cares (EU enterprise, regulated industries, public sector).

---

## Additional Tips

- **Pitch a comparison post** — tutorials are saturated; benchmarks and "X vs Verda for Y workload" posts tend to get more credits because they're harder to produce and more useful.
- **Use the credits to make the content** — once approved you can request an initial credit drop to cover the GPU hours you'll burn writing the piece, instead of paying out of pocket and waiting for reimbursement.
- The legacy domain **datacrunch.io** still resolves and `support@datacrunch.io` still reaches the team during the rebrand window — use it if the in‑app chat is offline.
- Verda has no signup‑bonus or always‑free tier — if you're hunting for instant credits, this provider is not the path. Pair this with one of the instant‑credit providers (e.g. Modal, Lightning AI) for prototyping.

## Submission 192: UK Sovereign AI Fund - up to £20M equity + 1M GPU hours + fast-track visas

- Category: Startup Programs
- Source Link: https://sovereignai.gov.uk/
- Amount: £1M-£20M equity + up to 1,000,000 GPU hours + 10 fast-track visas + £1M-£9M Strategic Assets grants
- Difficulty: 5/5 (Very Hard)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

The **UK Sovereign AI Fund** is a **£500 million government-backed venture capital unit** launched on **16 April 2026** by Technology Secretary Liz Kendall to back British AI startups and reduce the UK's reliance on foreign hyperscalers. It combines four instruments in a single application: **equity investment (£1M-£20M)**, **up to 1 million GPU hours** on UK supercomputers (Isambard-AI, Dawn) via the **AI Research Resource (AIRR)**, **fast-tracked Global Talent visas** (1-working-day decisions, 10 fully funded slots per backed startup), and access to **strategic assets** (curated national datasets, government contracts, grants up to £10M).

This is a **selective, government-equity instrument** — not a free-tier signup. Expect VC-style diligence, market-standard cap-table terms, and competitive selection focused on "AI that matters" to UK national interest. The first cheque went to **Callosum** (AI infrastructure); the first compute cohort included Prima Mente, Cosine, Cursive, Doubleword, Twig Bio, and Odyssey.

---

## Is This For Me?

**Probably yes if you are:**
- A **UK-registered company** doing substantive AI R&D in the UK
- Pre-seed through growth stage, building **frontier models, AI infrastructure, or applied AI** in one of the priority verticals
- A founder who needs **large-scale GPU compute** that would materially accelerate the project (not just routine inference)
- Hiring **international AI talent** and stuck on visa timelines

**Probably no if you are:**
- A non-UK entity (you must be UK-registered; non-UK partners can join only as consortium members on the grants track)
- Building a routine SaaS wrapper around someone else's API (the bar is "strategically significant" research/development)
- Looking for free credits to experiment over a weekend — this is equity + program access, not a self-serve console

---

## What You Actually Get

| Instrument | Amount | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Equity investment** | £1M-£20M | Pre-seed to growth; market-standard terms, market-speed execution |
| **Sovereign compute (AIRR)** | Up to **1,000,000 GPU hours** per startup | Fully funded; on Isambard-AI, Dawn, and other AIRR systems |
| **Fast-track visas** | Decisions in **1 working day** | Global Talent route; up to **10 fully funded visas** per backed startup for international R&D talent |
| **Strategic Assets grants** | £1M-£9M per grant (initial £9M pool) | For curated national datasets and autonomous/automated lab infrastructure |
| **Government contracts & data access** | Up to **£10M** in grants/contracts referenced on the fund site | Includes procurement support and curated UK national datasets |

*Sources: [sovereignai.gov.uk](https://sovereignai.gov.uk/), [GOV.UK announcement](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/ai-firms-pioneering-drug-discovery-cheaper-supercomputing-and-more-get-first-backing-through-uks-sovereign-ai)*

---

## Eligibility Requirements

All four instruments share a core eligibility floor:

1. **UK-registered entity** — companies, charities, universities, research organisations, or other UK-registered bodies. Consortia are permitted (non-UK partners only as supporting members on the grants track).
2. **Substantive AI R&D activity based in the UK** — work must occur in the UK; routine product deployment does not qualify.
3. **Clearly defined research or development programme** — not BAU operations.
4. **Material compute requirement** — for the AIRR allocation, you must show large-scale GPU compute would meaningfully accelerate the work.
5. **Strategic relevance to UK capability** — primary assessment dimension.

---

## Priority Focus Areas

Applications aligned with one of these six priority areas score better:

1. **Compute Efficiency & Sovereign Architecture** (chip-level efficiency, sovereign-grade infra)
2. **Next-generation AI Labs & Model Development** (frontier foundation models)
3. **Health & Life Sciences AI** (drug discovery, biological foundation models)
4. **AI for Scientific Discovery**
5. **AI Trust, Integrity & Assurance** (safety, evals, red-teaming)
6. **Dual-use & National Security AI Systems** (defence, intel)

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [sovereignai.gov.uk](https://sovereignai.gov.uk/) and read the programme overview.
2. Open the **single application form** at [sovereignai.gov.uk/compute-strategic-assets](https://www.sovereignai.gov.uk/compute-strategic-assets) — one form covers compute, equity, visas, and strategic assets.
3. Prepare your case:
   - Company snapshot (UK registration number, founders, stage, traction)
   - **Research/development programme description** (what you're building, why it's strategically significant)
   - **Compute justification** — how many GPU hours, on which AIRR system, what training/inference workload
   - **Scaling pathway** — how you become globally competitive
   - **Asks** — equity cheque size, visa count, dataset/contract access, grant amount
4. Submit. Expression of Interest assessment within **3 working days** (for Strategic Assets grants track).
5. If shortlisted, expect deeper diligence (technical, commercial, security where relevant).
6. Decisions: equity is rolling; **Strategic Assets grants** had full-application deadlines of **7 May 2026** and **5 June 2026** in the first round.

**Important:**
- Submit **one application** for everything you want — don't fragment.
- The fund explicitly markets "market-speed execution" — but this is government VC, so build a 4-12 week timeline expectation for equity, not days.
- Fast-track visa benefit only unlocks **after** acceptance to the programme.

---

## Strategic Assets Grants Track (Detail)

For teams whose ask is primarily a **dataset or autonomous lab infrastructure** rather than equity:

| Field | Detail |
|---|---|
| Grant range | £1M-£9M per grant |
| Initial round pool | £9M |
| Asset classes funded | High-value AI datasets; autonomous/automated laboratory infrastructure |
| Non-commercial track | Up to **100% of eligible costs** (open access, no commercial exploitation) |
| Commercial track | Typically **50%** (up to 70% in specific circumstances), requires private match |
| Eligible costs | Equipment, infrastructure development, intangible assets, initial commissioning |
| Ineligible | Ongoing operations, routine commercial activity, retrospective costs |
| First-round deadlines | 7 May 2026, 5 June 2026 (both 14:00 UK time) |

Apply via [find-government-grants.service.gov.uk](https://www.find-government-grants.service.gov.uk/grants/sovereign-ai-strategic-assets-grants-programme-1).

---

## Visa Fast-Track

- **Decisions in 1 working day** (vs typical Global Talent / Skilled Worker timelines of weeks)
- Up to **10 fully funded visas per backed startup** for international R&D talent
- Routes through the existing UK Global Talent visa, not a new visa class — the speed-up and funding are the benefits
- Only available **after** the startup is accepted into the Sovereign AI programme

---

## Equity Terms — What to Expect

- **Cheque size:** £1M-£20M (sources vary £10M-£20M ceiling; the GOV.UK launch announcement and PitchBook coverage cite up to £20M, the fund site shows up to £10M as a typical band)
- **Stage:** Pre-seed through growth
- **Terms:** "Market-standard" — expect priced equity, board observer or seat at larger cheques, standard pro-rata
- **Co-investment:** The fund is positioned to lead or co-lead alongside private VCs; not a passive grant
- **Strategic strings:** Implicit alignment with UK national priorities; expect reporting obligations on compute usage and milestones

---

## First Cohort (Public Reference Points)

|---|---|---|

| **Cursive** | Compute access | Agentic AI |
| **Doubleword** | Compute access | Sovereign inference infrastructure |
| **Twig Bio** | Compute access | Engineering biology |
| **Odyssey** | Compute access | AI for national security |

Use these as a calibration for the bar: serious technical teams, frontier or deep-tech work, UK-rooted.

---

## Caveats & Gotchas

- **Not a self-serve credit grant.** This is competitive equity + programmatic access. If you want fast free GPU credits, look at **Lambda Research Grants**, **Nebius Research Credits**, or **Prime Intellect Fast Compute Grants** instead.
- **UK-only registration.** Non-UK companies cannot lead an application. If you're a US/EU founder thinking about flipping to a UK Ltd, factor in the legal/tax cost.
- **Cheque-size ambiguity.** The fund's own homepage cites "up to £10M" as a typical band; press coverage and the GOV.UK launch announcement reference deals up to **£20M**. Treat £20M as the ceiling, £1M-£10M as the realistic working band.
- **Strategic Assets grants** had a first-round deadline of **5 June 2026** — check the GOV.UK Find a Grant page for any open subsequent rounds before applying.
- **VC ecosystem feedback** (per PitchBook reporting) flags that fund size relative to global frontier-model capex remains modest — useful for compute and seed/Series A leverage, less useful as a sole funder for foundation-model training runs at the multi-hundred-million scale.
- **Compute requests must be justified.** Asking for the full 1M GPU-hour cap without a concrete training/eval plan will fail diligence.

---

## Related UK Programs Worth Stacking

- **Innovate UK Frontier AI Discovery** — feasibility-study grants, separate competition (closes 10 June 2026).
- **AI Research Resource (AIRR)** — also accessible directly via academic routes for university researchers.
- **UK Global Talent Visa** — outside the Sovereign AI fast-track, the standard route still exists and is endorser-led.

## Submission 190: Tripo AI: 2,000 free API credits on signup + 300/month on Basic plan

- Source Link: https://www.tripo3d.ai/api
- Amount: 2,000 one-time API credits ($20) + 300 credits/month on Basic plan; up to 5,000 + 10,000 bonus credits for Tripo Game Hub developers
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Tripo AI is a **text-to-3D and image-to-3D model generation platform** with an OpenAPI for developers. Every new account gets **2,000 free API credits** the first time it generates an API key (worth **$20** at the standard rate of $0.01 per credit). On top of that, the **Basic web/Studio plan is free** and includes **300 monthly credits** for use inside Tripo Studio. Game developers building experiences for Tripo Game Hub can apply for an additional **5,000 credits ($50)** during development and earn **10,000 credits ($100)** automatically when their game passes review, with a lifetime cap of 5,000,000 credits.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

### A) Get the 2,000 free OpenAPI credits

1. Go to [platform.tripo3d.ai](https://platform.tripo3d.ai/).
2. Sign in with **email**, **Google**, or another supported social login (no credit card required).
3. Open the **API Keys** section in the platform dashboard.
4. Click **Generate API Key** — the **2,000 free credits** are credited to your account automatically the first time you create a key.
5. Copy the key and start calling the OpenAPI endpoints (text-to-3D, image-to-3D, multi-image-to-3D, refine, retopology, rigging, etc.).
6. To buy more, top up in **units of 100 credits ($1)** at $0.01/credit.

### B) Get the 300 monthly Basic-plan credits (Tripo Studio web app)

1. Go to [studio.tripo3d.ai](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/) and sign up with email/Google.
2. You’re placed on the **Basic plan** by default — **300 credits/month** are granted automatically.
3. Use credits inside the Studio web UI (text-to-3D, image-to-3D, etc.). Note: Basic-plan models are **public** and licensed under **CC BY 4.0** — not for commercial use.

### C) Apply for Game Hub credits (game developers only)

1. Build/prototype your game for [Tripo Game Hub](https://gamehub.tripo3d.ai/home).
2. Fill out the [Game Hub API Credit Application Form](https://forms.gle/Tkam6ngLGF3FrBhf9).
3. Wait up to **2 business days** for manual review.
4. If approved, **5,000 credits ($50)** are added for development/testing. You may reapply up to **twice per month** with a valid reason.
5. After your game passes the official Game Hub examination, **10,000 bonus credits ($100)** are added automatically (no extra form). Lifetime cap **5,000,000 credits ($50,000)**.

**Important caveats:**
- The **2,000 free OpenAPI credits** are a one-time grant per account, granted on first API-key creation — don’t generate keys before you’re ready.
- **No credit card** is required to claim the 2,000 free credits or the 300/month Basic credits.
- Game Hub credits are **strictly for developing on Tripo Game Hub**; the API key in your published game must match the one used during development. Misuse = permanent disqualification and credit removal.
- Free Basic-plan output is **public + CC BY 4.0**. If you need private models or commercial rights, you must upgrade (Professional plan starts at **$11.94/mo** for 3,000 credits).
- Free-tier OpenAPI concurrency is capped at **10 simultaneous Draft tasks** and **5 simultaneous Refine tasks**.

## Available AI Models / Features

Tripo exposes its full 3D-generation stack through both the OpenAPI and Tripo Studio:

| Capability | Description |
|---|---|
| **Text-to-Model** | Generate a 3D mesh from a natural-language prompt |
| **Image-to-Model** | Single-image to 3D reconstruction |
| **Multi-Image-to-3D** | Multi-view image input for higher-fidelity geometry |
| **Refine** | Higher-quality remesh + detail pass on a Draft model |

### Model versions currently exposed by the API

- **Tripo v1.4** — fast draft
- **Tripo v2.0** — accurate
- **Tripo v2.5** — balanced quality/speed
- **Tripo v3.0** — highest quality; sculpture-level geometry, sharp edges

Source: [tripo3d.ai/api](https://www.tripo3d.ai/api). Per-task credit costs vary by model version and feature; check the live pricing table on the platform dashboard before running large batches.

## Game Hub Eligibility & Process

The Game Hub Developer API Credits Program is open to anyone building a game that runs **on Tripo Game Hub** — there’s no specific revenue or studio-size threshold, but credits cannot be used outside the Game Hub ecosystem.

- **Application form:** [forms.gle/Tkam6ngLGF3FrBhf9](https://forms.gle/Tkam6ngLGF3FrBhf9)
- **Review SLA:** 2 business days (longer during high-volume periods)
- **Reapplication:** up to twice per month (must justify why you need more)
- **Launch bonus:** automatic on passing game examination — no form needed
- **Disqualifiers:** fraudulent behavior, using credits for non–Game-Hub work, or mismatched API keys between dev and published versions

## Additional Tips

- **Stack the freebies:** sign up at both `studio.tripo3d.ai` (300/mo) **and** `platform.tripo3d.ai` (one-time 2,000), they’re separate credit pools — same account.
- **Don’t generate the API key until you’re ready** — the 2,000 free OpenAPI credits drop the first time you create a key.
- **Top up small.** $1 buys 100 credits. There’s no monthly minimum on the OpenAPI side, so you can stay pay-as-you-go.
- **Watch the license.** If you ship anything commercial off Basic-plan output, you’re violating CC BY 4.0’s NoDerivatives-style restrictions Tripo applies on free output — use Professional+ or the OpenAPI for commercial work.
- **Use Drafts before Refines.** Refine tasks burn significantly more credits and are concurrency-limited to 5 — iterate on cheap Drafts first.
- **Game devs:** approval is manual but lightweight — a working prototype description on the form is usually enough to clear the first 5,000-credit grant.

## Submission 189: Trelis AI Grants (up to $500)

- Category: Free GPU & Compute
- Source Link: https://trelis.com/trelis-ai-grants
- Amount: Up to $500 per quarter (grant, equity-free); optional $10,000 SAFE investment track requires incorporation
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**Trelis Research** runs a small, founder-friendly grant program awarding **up to $500 per quarter** (equity-free) to **individuals** who are pushing forward the practical use of open AI models — training, fine-tuning, inferencing, or building tooling around model deployment. Applications are **rolling**, decisions land within ~30 days, and selected applicants get a **15-minute interview** before the grant is paid out. There is also an optional adjacent track: a **$10,000 SAFE investment** for projects that want capital and are willing to incorporate (Delaware C Corp preferred).

This is one of the lowest-friction "real-money" grants you can get as a solo builder: no PhD, no VC backing, no university affiliation, no specific country — just a GitHub/GitLab account and a project that actually moves open AI forward.

---

## Is this for me?

**Yes, if you are:**
- A solo builder, indie researcher, student, or hobbyist working on open-source AI.
- Someone who **trains** or **fine-tunes** open models (Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, etc.).
- Building **inference tooling** (servers, quantization, throughput tricks, eval harnesses, RAG pipelines, agent frameworks).
- Publishing reproducible work — code on GitHub/GitLab, models on HuggingFace, write-ups on a blog or Substack.
- Comfortable doing a 15-minute call in English.

**Probably not for you, if:**
- Your project is **closed-source** with no public artefacts.
- You are pitching a pure SaaS wrapper around a closed API (no model work, no novel tooling).
- You need >$500 of compute right now — this is a small grant, not a research budget. Pair it with [Prime Intellect Fast Compute Grants](https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/fast-compute-grants) ($500–$100K) or [Lambda Research Grants](https://lambdalabs.com/) for serious training runs.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [trelis.com/trelis-ai-grants](https://trelis.com/trelis-ai-grants/).
2. Read the page in full — it explicitly lists what qualifies (training, fine-tuning, inferencing, deployment tooling).
3. Click the application form link on the page.
4. Fill out the form. Expect to be asked for:
   - Your name, email, country.
   - **GitHub or GitLab profile** (this is mandatory — no GH/GL, no grant).
   - A short description of your project and how it advances open AI models.
   - Whether you want a **grant** (up to $500, no equity) or **investment** (~$10K SAFE, requires incorporation).
   - How you would use the money (compute, hardware, subscriptions, time).
5. **Wait up to 30 days** — Trelis commits to responding within 30 days of submission.
6. If shortlisted, you'll be emailed to schedule a **15-minute interview** on a rolling basis throughout the quarter.
7. Successful candidates get a grant offer. **Choose payout method:**
   - **Bank transfer** to 190+ countries (preferred, lowest fees).
   - **PayPal** or **Stripe** invoice.
   - **RunPod GPU credits** as a last resort if banking/PayPal isn't viable in your region.

**Important:**
- Grants are awarded **per quarter** ($500 cap per quarter), so timing matters — apply early in the quarter for best odds.
- The 30-day window is the **maximum** wait; many applicants hear back faster.
- The interview is short (15 min) and informal — it's a sanity check, not a Y Combinator pitch.
- You keep **100% of your IP**. Trelis explicitly states it "does not claim any rights to the work being done by the grantee."

---

## What Counts as "Advancing Open AI Models"?

Trelis defines this broadly. Eligible work includes:

| Area | Examples |
|---|---|
| **Training** | Pretraining experiments on open architectures, novel optimizers, dataset curation pipelines, small-scale reproductions of papers. |
| **Fine-tuning** | LoRA / QLoRA / full fine-tunes of Llama/Qwen/Mistral/etc., domain adapters, instruction-tuning datasets, RLHF/DPO/GRPO pipelines. |
| **Inferencing** | Quantization (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ), speculative decoding, batched inference servers, edge/CPU inference, throughput optimization. |
| **Deployment tooling** | Serving frameworks, model routers, observability for OSS models, evaluation harnesses, agent frameworks built on open models. |

If your project would land naturally in r/LocalLLaMA, on the HuggingFace trending tab, or in the Trelis YouTube channel's audience — it's a fit.

---

## Grant vs Investment Track

Trelis runs two parallel tracks on the same form:

### Grant ($500, no strings)
- Equity-free.
- No incorporation needed.
- Paid to an individual.
- Public announcement (with your permission) of name + 280-char summary + 500-word write-up.

### Investment (~$10,000 SAFE)
- Requires you to **incorporate within 30 days** (Delaware C Corp strongly preferred).
- Standard SAFE structure.
- Better fit if you're turning the project into a company; overkill for a side project.

Most solo builders should apply for the **grant** unless you already have company-building intent.

---

## Reporting Requirements

If you receive a grant, you must submit:
- **Title** of the project.
- **280-character tweet-style summary**.
- **500-word project summary**.

Trelis may publicly announce your name and summaries (with your permission). They don't claim rights to your code, models, or data.

---

## What's the Catch?

- **It's only $500.** Treat it as a "thank you / runway extender", not a serious compute budget. $500 buys you ~50–100 hours on a single H100 on the cheap providers, or a few months of a Pro subscription, or a chunk of a fine-tuning run.
- **Quarterly cap.** Trelis only funds a small handful of grants per quarter — if your application is borderline, expect to wait or re-apply next quarter.
- **GitHub/GitLab is mandatory.** No public code history → very hard sell.
- **Interview is required.** Asynchronous-only applications won't be funded.
- **No restrictions on use of funds, but** Trelis clearly favors compute, hardware, and subscriptions that directly produce open artefacts.

---

## Tips for a Strong Application

- **Link a concrete repo or HuggingFace model**, not a landing page or pitch deck.
- **Be specific** about what the $500 unlocks — "30 hours on an H100 to fine-tune Qwen2.5-7B on dataset X" beats "compute for experiments".
- **Show momentum** — a half-finished project with commits in the last month beats a polished idea with no code.
- **Pick the grant track** unless you're genuinely company-building.
- **Apply early in the quarter** (Jan / Apr / Jul / Oct) to maximise the chance the quarterly slot is still open.
- **Watch the [Trelis Research YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/@TrelisResearch)** to calibrate the kind of work that resonates with Ronan (the founder) — practical, reproducible, OSS-first.

---

## Additional Tips

- The grant is **global** — no country restriction, no tax-residency requirement. Bank transfers reach 190+ countries.
- If you're in a country where USD bank transfers are painful, **PayPal/Stripe** or **RunPod credits** are explicit fallbacks.
- Pair this grant with bigger compute programs if you need scale: [Prime Intellect Fast Compute Grants](https://www.primeintellect.ai/blog/fast-compute-grants), [Lambda Research](https://lambdalabs.com/), [Nebius Research Credits](https://nebius.com/nebius-research-credits-program), [TensorWave OSS Developer Program](https://go.tensorwave.com/open-source-developer-program).
- The most recent grant cohort listed on the page is **1Q2026**, so the program is confirmed active as of May 2026.

- [Trelis Research on GitHub](https://github.com/orgs/TrelisResearch/repositories)
