## Additional Tips

- **Specificity wins.** A vague "we want to train LLMs" proposal underperforms a concrete "we will fine-tune Llama-3.3-70B on dataset X for task Y, requiring N GPU-days" pitch. Reviewers want to see realistic resource math.
- **Lead with impact.** Mention target venues (NeurIPS, ICML, etc.), open-sourcing plans, and reproducibility — these all map to "transparent resource utilization" criteria.
- **The 8 GPUs / 10M tokens are ceilings, not defaults.** Smaller, well-justified asks have a better hit rate than maximum requests with thin justification.
- **Co-marketing is part of the deal** — be ready to acknowledge Nebius in papers, and possibly contribute a blog post or testimonial. If your university blocks corporate acknowledgements, check first.
- **Once-per-lifetime rule.** Don't burn your application on a half-baked proposal — wait until you have a polished plan.
- **Alternative if rejected:** Nebius runs a separate [Startups program](https://nebius.com/startups/apply) (different eligibility) and pay-as-you-go GPU pricing starts around $2.95/hr for HGX H100.

## Submission 167: NAIRR Pilot - National AI Research Resource (graduate students eligible)

- Category: Education & Student
- Source Link: https://nairrpilot.org/opportunities/allocations
- Amount: 12-month allocations on NAIRR resources (GPU compute, foundation model API credits, datasets); Start-Up class up to 2,000 GPU-hours / 480,000 SUs for 3 months
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

The **National AI Research Resource (NAIRR) Pilot** is a federal program (NSF + DOE + NIH + DARPA + 26 partners including NVIDIA, Microsoft, AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face) connecting US-based researchers and educators to **AI compute, datasets, and foundation models** at no cost. Graduate students can apply individually with a faculty support letter. Two main allocation classes: a fast-track **Start-Up** (3 months, decided in ~3 weeks) for new users / feasibility, and full **Research/Educational** allocations (12 months) for established projects. As of 2026 the pilot has supported 600+ projects and 6,000+ students.

---

## Is This For Me?

**Yes, if you are:**
- A US-based researcher, educator, or graduate student at a US academic institution, non-profit, federal agency / FFRDC, state / local / tribal agency, or a startup / small business with a federal grant
- Able to use an **institutional email** (gmail/outlook/personal addresses are rejected)
- Doing AI / ML research that you can publish openly (this is a hard requirement: "All project results must be open and publishable")

**No, if you are:**
- Outside the US, or working at a non-US institution
- A grad student without a faculty advisor willing to write a one-page support letter
- Building closed / proprietary / commercial-only IP — output has to be public

---

## Allocation Classes (pick one)

| Class | Duration | Decision time | Best for |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Start-Up** | 3 months | ~3 weeks | New users, feasibility studies, one-resource trials |
| **Research Resources** | **12 months** | Monthly review (submit by 15th) | Established research projects |
| **Educational Resources** | 12 months | Monthly review | Classroom / training use |
| **Sandbox Projects** | varies | rolling | Quick experimentation with NAIRR-hosted services |
| **Deep Partnerships** | varies | by invitation | Large-scale / cross-cutting collaborations |

**Start-Up is the recommended entry point for first-time users and grad students.**

---

## Start-Up Allocation Limits (one resource per request)

| Resource | Limit |
|---|---|
| **PSC Bridges-2 GPU** | up to 2,000 GPU-hours |
| **Purdue Anvil AI** | up to 2,000 GPU-hours |
| **SDSC Expanse AI** | up to 2,000 GPU-hours |
| **TACC Vista** | up to 2,000 GPU-hours |
| **Indiana U Jetstream-2** | up to 128,000 SUs |
| **Texas A&M ACES** | up to 480,000 SUs |
| **DOE ANL AI Testbed** | up to 500 node-hours |
| **PSC Neocortex (Cerebras CS-2)** | up to 50 CS-2 hours |

Research / Educational allocations can request more on multiple resources at once (size justified by the proposal).

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [nairrpilot.org/opportunities/allocations](https://nairrpilot.org/opportunities/allocations) and pick the allocation class (Start-Up recommended for first-timers).
2. Create an account on the **NAIRR Pilot Portal** at [submit-nairr.xras.org](https://submit-nairr.xras.org/) using your **institutional email**. Personal addresses (gmail, outlook, etc.) will be rejected.
3. Browse the **Resource Catalog** and choose the resource(s) you want (only one for Start-Up).
4. Prepare a **3-page PDF proposal** covering: scientific/educational goal, methodology, why this resource, justification of requested amount, related funding/grants.
5. **Graduate students:** ask your faculty advisor for a **letter of support** (typically one page) confirming they are sponsoring your work. Upload it with the proposal.
6. Submit through the portal. Specify your preferred resource provider(s).
7. Wait for decision: **~3 weeks for Start-Up**, **end of month for Research/Educational** if submitted by the 15th.
8. Once awarded, log into the chosen provider (PSC, SDSC, TACC, etc.) using the credentials NAIRR provisions, and start using the allocation. Awards last 12 months (or 3 for Start-Up).

**Important:**
- Only **one resource** per Start-Up request. Need more? Submit a Research Resources request later.
- All output must be **publishable** — no closed/proprietary results.
- Required progress reports at **1 month, 6 months, and final** completion.
- Usage data is shared with partner agencies.

---

## Graduate Student Path (the faculty letter)

Grad students are explicitly eligible to **submit their own proposals** — you do not need your advisor to be the PI. What you do need:

- A **letter of support from your faculty supervisor** (mandatory). Typical contents: confirms you are their student, briefly endorses the research plan, confirms institutional affiliation. One page is enough.
- An **institutional (.edu) email** — the portal will reject signups from gmail/outlook.
- The same 3-page PDF proposal as everyone else.

No faculty letter is required for postdocs, faculty PIs, or staff researchers — only for grad students.

---

## Available Resources (highlights)

NAIRR aggregates compute, models, and data from US national labs, universities, and 26 industry partners. The **full catalog** is on [submit-nairr.xras.org/resources](https://submit-nairr.xras.org/resources) and changes frequently.

### Compute (HPC + AI testbeds)
- **NSF systems:** PSC Bridges-2 GPU, PSC Neocortex (Cerebras CS-2), SDSC Expanse AI, TACC Vista, Purdue Anvil, Indiana U Jetstream-2, Texas A&M ACES
- **DOE systems:** ALCF AI Testbed (Cerebras, Graphcore, Groq, SambaNova accelerators), OLCF, NERSC
- **NIH:** STRIDES cloud credits via AWS / Azure / GCP
- **Industry partners:** Microsoft Azure credits, AWS credits, NVIDIA DGX Cloud, Hugging Face

### Foundation Models / APIs (via partners)
- **OpenAI** API credits
- **Anthropic** Claude API credits
- **NVIDIA** NIM-hosted models (Llama, Mistral, etc.)
- **Hugging Face** Inference Endpoints
- **Microsoft** Azure OpenAI Service access

### Datasets
- Curated public scientific datasets via partner platforms (NIH, DOE, NSF program data)
- Data hosting on partner clouds where licensing permits

Exact partner offerings rotate — always check the live catalog before drafting your proposal.

---

## Gotchas & Tips

- **Open-publishing requirement** is non-negotiable. If your work is under an NDA or is commercial-only, NAIRR is not for you.
- **Pick the right resource the first time.** Start-Up only allows one resource per request; switching mid-allocation is painful.
- **Submit Start-Up first**, then upgrade to Research Resources once you have early results — the Start-Up serves as evidence the project is viable.
- The pilot is funded through 2026 with the goal of informing a **permanent** NAIRR. Allocations may be paused or restructured if Congress doesn't renew funding — submit early in the year.
- **NAIRR does not provide a credit-card-equivalent generic budget.** You request a specific resource (e.g., 2,000 H100 hours on Vista) and you use only that.
- For classroom use, **Educational Resources** is the right class — it's tuned for cohorts of students rather than a single PI.
- The 3-week Start-Up turnaround is real and consistent — much faster than DOE INCITE or NSF ACCESS Maximize.

---

## Related Programs (if NAIRR is not a fit)

- **NSF ACCESS** — non-AI-specific HPC allocations, also free for US researchers, no faculty letter required for grad students at the smallest tier ([access-ci.org](https://access-ci.org))
- **DOE INCITE** — large allocations (100K-1M+ node-hours) on Frontier/Aurora/Polaris, but very competitive
- **EuroHPC AI Factories** — EU equivalent
- **NIH STRIDES** — biomedical-specific cloud credits

## Submission 166: NVIDIA-hosted Kimi K2.5 / K2.6: free chat + API key, no payment details

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://build.nvidia.com/moonshotai/kimi-k2.5/modelcard
- Amount: Free OpenAI-compatible API access to Kimi K2.5 and K2.6 (plus 100+ other models) at ~40 requests/minute. No token cap, no expiry.
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Moonshot's own platform at [platform.moonshot.ai](https://platform.moonshot.ai/) requires a **$1 minimum top-up** before you can issue an API key — there is no truly free tier. NVIDIA solves that for you: it hosts Moonshot's flagship **Kimi K2.5** (and the newer **Kimi K2.6**) on its [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com/) inference catalogue, where any free **NVIDIA Developer Program** account gets a **playground** for in-browser chat plus an **OpenAI-compatible API key** (prefix `nvapi-`) without entering a credit card. Rate-limited (commonly **~40 requests/min** per model) but otherwise unmetered for prototyping — a clean way to evaluate Moonshot's Kimi line without paying Moonshot a cent.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to the model card: [build.nvidia.com/moonshotai/kimi-k2.5](https://build.nvidia.com/moonshotai/kimi-k2.5/modelcard) (or [/kimi-k2.6](https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/moonshotai-kimi-k2-6) for the newer revision).
2. Click **"Try API"** / **"Get API Key"** in the right panel.
3. Sign in or create a free **NVIDIA account** — email + password, or SSO (Google/GitHub-style federated). **No credit card, no phone SMS.**
4. Confirm your email — this enrolls you in the **NVIDIA Developer Program** automatically.
5. Back on the model card, click **"Get API Key"** again → it generates an `nvapi-...` token. **Copy it immediately** — it is shown once.
6. Use it as a drop-in OpenAI key:

   ```python
   from openai import OpenAI
   client = OpenAI(
       base_url="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
       api_key="nvapi-...",
   )
   resp = client.chat.completions.create(
       model="moonshotai/kimi-k2.5",
       messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}],
   )
   ```

**Important:**
- The same key works for **all 100+ models** in the NIM catalogue (Llama Nemotron, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, etc.) — not just Kimi.
- The legacy **"1,000 credits on signup"** scheme was retired in early 2025; today it's purely rate-limited, no credit balance to exhaust.
- Some accounts get a **"Request More"** button visible on build.nvidia.com that bumps the rate cap (historically up to ~5,000 inference units), useful if you hit limits during a hackathon.
- Account verification is occasionally manual for new sign-ups — if your key has zero quota, post in the [NVIDIA Developer Forums (Access/Accounts)](https://forums.developer.nvidia.com/c/access-accounts/) for a fix.

---

## Available Kimi Models on NVIDIA NIM

| Model | Endpoint slug | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **Kimi K2.5** | `moonshotai/kimi-k2.5` | Trillion-parameter MoE, ~32B active. Multimodal (text + vision via the `kimi-k2.5` VLM card). 256K context. |
| **Kimi K2.5 Multimodal VLM** | `moonshotai/kimi-k2.5` (vision branch) | Image + text input, GPU-accelerated NIM endpoint. |
| **Kimi K2.6** | `moonshotai/kimi-k2.6` | Newer revision — improved reasoning + tool use. Same free-tier policy. |

All endpoints are **OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible** at `https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1` — works with the official `openai` SDK in Python/Node, plus drop-in tools like Kilo Code, OpenCode, Cline, Continue, and aider. See the [official model list](https://build.nvidia.com/models).

---

## Free Tier Limits (NVIDIA NIM hosted)

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| **Cost** | $0 — no credit card, no auto-billing |
| **Rate limit** | ~40 requests/minute (varies by model and current cluster load) |
| **Token quota** | None disclosed — effectively unmetered while staying under RPM |
| **Concurrency** | Soft limits; long context requests can return 429 under load |
| **Trial expiry** | None — Developer Program membership doesn't expire |
| **Production use** | Allowed for **development, testing, prototyping, research**. For production traffic, NVIDIA expects you to either self-host the NIM container (free 90-day **NVIDIA AI Enterprise** trial) or move to a paid hosted partner. |

---

## Compared to Moonshot's Native Platform

| | NVIDIA NIM (free) | platform.moonshot.ai |
|---|---|---|
| Credit card / payment | **Not required** | **$1 minimum top-up required to activate** |
| Free credits | None disclosed, but unmetered under 40 RPM | **$5 voucher** unlocks after $5 cumulative recharge |
| Endpoint | `integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1` | `api.moonshot.ai/v1` |
| Model freshness | K2.5 + K2.6 currently mirrored | Always-newest models land here first |
| Rate scaling | Fixed RPM | Scales with cumulative recharge |
| Best for | **Free evaluation, prototyping, fallback API** | Production once you've validated and need higher throughput |

**Bottom line:** if you just want to run Kimi against your prompts/agents without committing money, NVIDIA's hosted NIM is the path. If you're already shipping and need scale, eventually move to Moonshot's own platform (or OpenRouter at ~$0.44/M input, ~$2/M output for Kimi K2.5).

---

## Caveats & Gotchas (verified May 2026)

- **Region**: `build.nvidia.com` is globally accessible, but the NVIDIA Developer Program signup may show extra KYC fields for some sanctioned regions. EU/US/UK/Asia-Pacific are smooth.
- **NVIDIA may rate-limit aggressively** on popular models during launch periods or peak hours — expect 429s on Kimi K2.6 in the days right after release.
- **Same key, shared bucket**: if you blast Llama Nemotron at 40 RPM, you may temporarily reduce headroom on Kimi calls.
- **No SLA, no support tickets** on the free tier — for outages, watch the NVIDIA Developer Forums.
- **Output tokens are capped per request** (typically 4K-8K depending on model) — for long generations, chunk and stream.
- **No fine-tuning, no batch API** on the free tier — chat completions and embeddings only.

---

## Additional Tips

- **OpenRouter** also exposes Kimi K2.5 with **no upfront recharge required** (pay-as-you-go from any topped-up OpenRouter balance) — good plan-B if NIM rate-limits you.
- **Z.AI's GLM-4.5-Flash / 4.7-Flash / 4.6V-Flash** are *unconditionally free* via API and broadly comparable to Kimi for many tasks — see the separate Z.AI entry in this dataset.
- Pair NIM-hosted Kimi with coding agents (**Kilo Code**, **OpenCode**, **Cline**, **aider**, **Continue**) by setting `OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1` and `OPENAI_API_KEY=nvapi-...`.
- The NVIDIA Developer Program also unlocks free credits/discounts on **NVIDIA Brev** GPU instances and **DGX Cloud Lepton** trials — same login.

## Submission 165: MongoDB for Startups - up to $5,000 in Atlas credits

- Category: Startup Programs
- Source Link: https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/startups
- Amount: Up to $5,000 Atlas credits + Voyage AI tokens + partner credits (Fireworks AI, Temporal) + 1:1 technical advisor
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**MongoDB for Startups** gives early-stage companies up to **$5,000 in MongoDB Atlas credits** (50% more than the prior cap, after the program's October 2025 expansion), plus **Voyage AI tokens** for embeddings/reranking, a **1:1 technical advisor session**, and **matching credits** at partner stack companies (Fireworks AI for inference, Temporal for workflow orchestration). It's one of the lowest-friction startup programs in the database stack — Series A or earlier, less than 7 years old, single product. No VC backing required.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [mongodb.com/solutions/startups](https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/startups) and click **"Apply now"**.
2. Fill in the application form:
   - Email, first/last name, job title
   - Company name, company URL, founder LinkedIn profile
   - Product/service description (one or two sentences — make it clear you're a single product, not an agency)
   - Country, ZIP code, funding stage, industry
   - Whether you have an AI use case (yes/no)
3. Submit. **Response typically arrives within 5 business days.**
4. On acceptance, you receive a welcome email containing a unique **Atlas promo code** (and instructions for the partner perks).
5. Activate the credits:
   - Log into [account.mongodb.com](https://account.mongodb.com)
   - Go to **Billing** → click **Apply Code** → paste your activation code → **Submit**
   - You must be **Organization Owner** or **Organization Billing Admin** to apply the code.
6. Voyage AI tokens are activated separately via the same welcome email instructions; partner perks (Fireworks, Temporal) come with their own redemption links.

**Faster track via partners:**
- If your VC, accelerator, or incubator is a MongoDB partner, ask them to refer you — referrals usually get reviewed faster and may unlock larger credit allocations.
- Partner contact: `startups@mongodb.com`.

You must check **all** of these boxes:

| Criterion | Requirement |

## What You Get

### MongoDB Atlas credits — up to $5,000
- Usable across the full Atlas product line: dedicated clusters, serverless instances, Atlas Search, **Atlas Vector Search**, Atlas Stream Processing, Database Triggers, Charts, Online Archive, Data Federation.
- 12 months to **activate** the promo code after acceptance, then 12 months to **use** the credits.
- Extension is granted on a case-by-case basis if you request it when ~3 months remain.
- **Tip:** the $5,000 cap is the maximum; actual allocation can be lower if you're very early (e.g. pre-product). Partner-referred and AI-focused startups tend to get the full amount.

### Voyage AI tokens (embeddings + rerank)
- **Voyage AI** was acquired by MongoDB in 2025 — it builds best-in-class embedding and reranker models (voyage-4-large, voyage-context-3, voyage-code-3, rerank-2.5, etc.).
- The startup program gives **dedicated tokens beyond the standard 200M free tier**, packaged with your acceptance email. Use these for production-grade RAG, semantic search, and reranking.
- Models cover text, code, multimodal (text+image), and domain-specific use cases.

### Partner credits — Fireworks AI & Temporal
- **Fireworks AI** — fast OSS LLM inference (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, etc.). Matching credits help you stand up the inference layer next to your Atlas Vector Search.
- **Temporal** — durable workflow orchestration. Matching credits cover Temporal Cloud usage for long-running agent/job orchestration.
- Exact amounts are negotiated by MongoDB with the partner and disclosed in the welcome email.

### Technical advisor (1:1 session)
- One free expert session with a MongoDB solutions architect to review your data model, indexing strategy, and architecture.
- Useful early — the wrong shard key or schema design will follow you to production.

### Marketing & co-marketing
- Eligibility for **MongoDB Startup Spotlight** (case study, blog post, social amplification).
- Access to MongoDB events and the founder community.

### Developer Support Plan (optional, paid)
- $49/month after a free 30-day trial (24/7 in-app chat + support portal).
- Crucially, **you can pay for it with your Atlas credits** — so it's effectively free during the credit window.

## Application Tips & Gotchas

- **Have a real website and LinkedIn page before applying** — "coming soon" splash pages are a common rejection reason.
- **Mention your AI use case explicitly** if you have one. The program leans hard into AI/RAG workloads since the Voyage acquisition; AI-native applications tend to get full $5K allocations.
- **Don't apply twice from the same company.** "Not previously accepted" is enforced at the company level — pivots/rebrands need to email `startups@mongodb.com` to discuss.
- **The 12-month activation window is real.** Apply when you actually intend to use Atlas in production, not as a "just in case" stash.
- **Credits do not roll over** after the 12-month usage window unless you proactively request an extension when ~3 months remain.
- The Atlas credit cannot be cashed out, transferred, or applied to non-Atlas MongoDB products.

## Additional Tips

- **For YC, Techstars, and other top accelerator portfolio companies** — go through the partner referral path; allocations and onboarding are smoother.
- **Pair this with the Voyage AI standalone free tier** (200M tokens, no application needed) for early prototyping before you burn program tokens.
- **Atlas free tier (M0)** is permanent — you can prototype on a free 512MB cluster while your application is pending.
- **Combine with**: Fireworks AI startup credits, Temporal Cloud free credits, and partner perks from your VC/accelerator (HubSpot, Notion, AWS Activate) for a near-zero-cost early stack.

## Submission 164: Mixedbread: $5 one-time free credits, no credit card

- Category: AI API Free Tiers
- Source Link: https://www.mixedbread.com/pricing
- Amount: $5 one-time credits, 100 RPM, 10 stores, 3 workspace users
- Difficulty: 1/5 (Instant)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Mixedbread (Berlin-based AI search/retrieval platform — best known for the open-source `mxbai-embed-large` and `mxbai-rerank` model families) offers a **Starter** tier with **$5 one-time credits** and **no credit card required** to sign up. The credits are spent against usage-based pricing for embeddings (indexing), search queries, reranking, and storage on their hosted **Stores** (managed vector index + retrieval pipeline). Free tier is rate-limited to **100 requests/min** and capped at **10 stores** + **3 workspace users**.

This is a true "try before you buy" play — small enough that you'll burn through it on a serious indexing job, but generous enough to validate semantic search / RAG / multimodal retrieval against a real index without committing a card.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [mixedbread.com](https://www.mixedbread.com/) and click **"Sign in"** (top-right) — or jump straight to the [pricing page](https://www.mixedbread.com/pricing) and click **"Start free"** on the Starter card.
2. Sign up with **email** or **Google / GitHub** OAuth — no credit card prompted.
3. Confirm your email if prompted.
4. You land in the **Mixedbread Platform** dashboard. The $5 credit is auto-applied to the workspace.
5. Create an **API key** under *Settings → API Keys*.
6. Create your first **Store** (managed retrieval index) via the dashboard or the [Quickstart](https://www.mixedbread.com/docs) — or hit the inference endpoints directly with the Python / Node SDK.

**Important:**
- **No credit card on file** — when the $5 runs out, the API just stops serving 402 errors. Nothing auto-bills.
- Credits are **one-time, per workspace** (don't expect to spin up new workspaces to refresh them).
- The Starter tier is for experimentation — for anything production you'll want **Scale** ($20/mo flat + usage).

---

## What You Can Do With $5

The credits draw down against Mixedbread's usage-based pricing:

| Service | Price | What $5 buys |
|---|---|---|
| **Indexing — Fast** (embed for ingestion) | $1.50 / 1M tokens | ~3.3M tokens of content indexed |
| **Indexing — High Quality** | $3 / 1M tokens | ~1.6M tokens indexed |
| **Search — Basic** (vector retrieval) | $4 / 1K queries | ~1,250 queries |
| **Search — Rerank** (vector + cross-encoder rerank) | $7.50 / 1K queries | ~660 queries |
| **Storage** | $0.50 / 1M tokens / month | 10M tokens stored for 1 month |

In practice: you can index a small-to-medium knowledge base (tens of thousands of chunks), run a few hundred reranked queries, and host it for a month — all on the free $5.

## Available Models (Hosted via Managed API)

All models run on Mixedbread's hosted endpoints — no GPU needed locally.

### Embedding models
- **`mxbai-embed-large-v1`** — flagship English embedding model, 335M params, 1024 dims, 512-token context. SOTA among BERT-large-sized models on MTEB at release; outperforms OpenAI `text-embedding-3-large` on several benchmarks.
- **`mxbai-embed-xsmall-v1`** — efficient retrieval-focused embedding, 22.7M params, 384 dims. Built for high-throughput / low-latency.
- **ColBERT** (multi-vector / late interaction) — contextualized late-interaction retrieval; combines dense vectors with cross-encoder-style scoring.

### Reranker models
- **`mxbai-rerank-large-v2`** — flagship reranker, multilingual (100+ languages), SOTA accuracy.
- **`mxbai-rerank-base-v2`** — smaller / faster reranker, also multilingual.
- **`mxbai-rerank-large-v1`** / **`mxbai-rerank-base-v1`** — first-generation, English-focused.

### Other services
- **Document Parsing** — managed OCR + structure extraction (PDFs, docs, images) feeding directly into Stores.
- **Stores** — end-to-end managed retrieval: chunking, embedding, indexing, hybrid search, rerank, MCP server access.

Source: [Mixedbread Models Docs](https://www.mixedbread.com/docs/models) · [Embeddings Inference Docs](https://www.mixedbread.com/docs/inference/embedding)

## Tips & Gotchas

- **No credit card means hard stop, not auto-charge** — great for experimentation, but plan to upgrade before a launch.
- **Use `xsmall` for indexing huge corpora** — at 384 dims and lower per-token cost, you'll get more bang for the $5 than `large-v1`.

- **Open-source escape hatch** — if you outgrow the credit, every flagship model (`mxbai-embed-large-v1`, `mxbai-rerank-large-v2`, etc.) is on Hugging Face under permissive licenses; you can self-host on any GPU box (or even CPU for the small variants).

### Description

Mistral AI's startup program — originally launched as **Mistralship** in late 2024 — gives selected early-stage startups up to **€30,000 (~$30,000) in La Plateforme API credits**, plus 1:1 support from Mistral's Solutions & Science team and early access to new models. ### Path A — Direct outreach to Mistral (recommended for fundable startups)

## Submission 162: Le Chat Student (50%+ off Le Chat Pro)

- Category: Education & Student
- Source Link: https://help.mistral.ai/en/articles/347553-as-a-student-am-i-eligible-for-a-discount-on-le-chat-pro
- Amount: ~53% off Le Chat Pro — roughly $7.04/month vs $14.99/month (renewable yearly while enrolled)
- Difficulty: 2/5 (Easy)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

Mistral AI's **Le Chat Student** plan gives verified students **all the features of Le Chat Pro at ~53% off** — roughly **$7.04/month** instead of $14.99/month. Verification is automatic for recognized **.edu / institutional email domains**, with a manual review path available if your school's domain isn't on the list. Renewable each academic year while you stay enrolled.

This is one of the cheapest ways to get a serious frontier-model chatbot subscription if you have any institutional email — no GPA requirements, no SheerID flow, no lengthy application. If your school email auto-resolves, you're paying in under 60 seconds.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [chat.mistral.ai](https://chat.mistral.ai/) and sign in (or create an account) — Google, Microsoft, Apple, or email/password all work
2. Navigate to **Settings → Subscription** (or directly to the Le Chat Plans page)
3. Look for the **Student** plan card and click **Upgrade / Subscribe**
4. Enter your **student/institutional email address** (e.g. `you@university.edu`, `you@uni.ac.uk`, `you@uni.fr`, etc.)
5. **Automatic verification** — if your domain is in Mistral's recognized list, you're approved instantly and can complete checkout
6. **Manual verification** (only if your domain isn't recognized) — click **Request email check** at the bottom of the page; Mistral's team will manually verify the email is a real institutional address
7. Add a payment method and complete the discounted subscription (~$7.04/month)

**Important:**
- The **only thing being verified is the email itself** — Mistral does **not** accept enrollment certificates, transcripts, or student ID uploads. If your domain is unrecognized AND looks non-institutional, you may be denied.
- **Renewal is yearly** — you'll need to re-verify each academic year that you're still enrolled.
- You can **switch your account email later** without losing data — useful when you graduate and need to move off the student plan, or want to try a different institutional email.
- Pricing shown above is in USD; local pricing may vary slightly with currency / VAT.

---

## Eligibility — Who Qualifies

- **Active students** at an educational institution
- Must possess a **valid student/institutional email address** issued by your school
- Works with `.edu` (US), `.ac.uk` (UK), `.edu.au` (Australia), and most country-specific academic TLDs (`.fr` university domains, `.de` `uni-` domains, etc.) — the recognition list is broad

**Who does NOT qualify:**
- People with only a personal Gmail/Outlook address (no institutional email = no plan)
- Alumni whose school email was deactivated
- Bootcamp/MOOC students without an issued institutional address
- Faculty/staff (the discount is for students; faculty should contact sales for education pricing)

## Domain Verification — What If My School Isn't Recognized?

If the auto-detector doesn't recognize your institutional domain (common for smaller schools, regional universities, or newer programs):

1. On the verification screen, scroll to the bottom and click **"Request email check"**
2. Submit the request — Mistral's team manually reviews whether the domain is a legitimate educational institution
3. **Only the email validity is checked** — they will NOT review enrollment certificates, transcripts, student ID cards, or any other documents
4. Wait for confirmation (typically a few business days), then return to subscribe

If manual review fails, you have no further recourse beyond using a different institutional email if you have one.

- **Mistralship** (Mistral's startup program) is a separate offering with up to ~$30K in API credits for early-stage startups — check that if you're building something, not just chatting.
- **API vs Le Chat**: This discount is for the **Le Chat consumer app only**. It does NOT include free Mistral API tokens (`api.mistral.ai`). If you want API access, you'll still pay per-token API rates.
- **Cancel anytime** — subscription is monthly, so you can downgrade to Free without losing your account or chats.

4. You land in the workspace with **100 credits already loaded** — no credit card required, no phone verification.
5. Pick a workflow from the sidebar (Text to 3D, Image to 3D, AI Texturing, Animate) and start generating.

**Important:**
- **No API access** on the Free plan — the Pro plan ($15/mo billed annually, or $20/mo monthly) is the entry point for the API.

### Description

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

4. (Optional but recommended) Click **"API Key + Billing"** in the top nav and **sign in** — Google login or email — to permanently associate the key with your account; otherwise the auto-key is only tied to your browser/IP and you can lose it

**Important:**
- **No credit card required** for the 10M free tokens
- The 10M tokens are **shared across every Search Foundation API** (one wallet, many APIs)
- After 10M tokens are used, you must top up — packages start small (no monthly subscription required)
- An anonymous auto-generated key is tied to your browser/IP — sign in to make it portable
- **Reader API works without ANY key** for casual use (20 RPM); the Search endpoint (`s.jina.ai`) requires a key

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [inference.net](https://inference.net/) and click **Sign up** (or jump straight to the docs at [docs.inference.net](https://docs.inference.net)).
2. Create an account with email or a supported SSO option.

6. Export the key locally:
   ```bash
   export INFERENCE_API_KEY=<your-api-key>
   ```
7. Point any OpenAI SDK at `https://api.inference.net/v1` and you're done — the first request will start drawing from the $25 balance.

**Important:**
- No credit card required to claim the $25 (verified via signup flow + docs).

---

## API Compatibility (OpenAI Drop-In)

Inference.net is a **strict OpenAI-compatible endpoint**. Migrating from OpenAI / Anthropic / Together / DeepInfra is a one-line change:

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.inference.net/v1",
    api_key=os.environ["INFERENCE_API_KEY"],
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="google/gemma-3-27b-instruct/bf-16",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
```

Supported features:
- **Chat completions** (primary endpoint)
- **Structured outputs** (JSON schema)
- **Function / tool calling** via `tools` parameter
- **Streaming** responses

## What $25 Actually Buys

Using the cheapest catalog model (**Schematron 3B**, $0.02 input / $0.05 output per 1M tokens):
- ~**1.25 billion input tokens**, or
- ~**500 million output tokens**, or
- A typical 50/50 split: hundreds of millions of tokens

Using **Gemma 3 vision** ($0.15 / $0.30 per 1M tokens):
- ~166 million input tokens / ~83 million output tokens

Using **Nemotron 3 Super** ($2.50 / $5.00 per 1M):
- ~10 million input tokens / 5 million output tokens (still huge for evaluation)

The $25 grant is genuinely useful — well beyond a token-tasting demo.

---

## Open-Source Grants Program (separate from $25)

If you maintain or contribute to an open-source AI project, Inference.net runs a **Grants Program** offering free compute beyond the $25 starter:
- Free compute credits for OSS AI projects
- Applications reviewed within ~24 hours
- Useful for OSS model authors, eval frameworks, agent libraries, etc.

Apply via the Grants link on [inference.net](https://inference.net/).

---

## Catalyst (Full LLM Lifecycle Platform)

The $25 also unlocks **Catalyst**, Inference.net's broader platform:
- **Observe** — log production LLM traffic
- **Datasets** — manage eval/training data
- **Evaluate** — compare model quality
- **Train** — fine-tune custom models from your traffic
- **Deploy** — serve fine-tunes on dedicated GPU infra

This matters if you want to start with the free credits, then graduate to fine-tuning your own task-specific small model (the Schematron family is their reference example of this pipeline).

---

## What's the Catch?

- **No catch on the $25** — no card required, no auto-billing, balance simply runs out and your API calls start returning 402-style errors until you top up.
- **Frontier OSS models are GPU-hour priced** ($9.98/hr on B200), so a couple of hours of testing Kimi K2.5 / GLM-5 / GPT-OSS-120B will eat the $25 quickly. Use Schematron / Gemma 3 for long-running token-cheap workloads.
- **No published rate-limit ceiling** for free-tier accounts — typical OpenAI-compatible limits apply; high-RPS workloads should contact sales.
- **Catalog evolves fast** — model availability and pricing change; always re-check the live [models page](https://inference.net/models) and [pricing page](https://inference.net/pricing/) before committing code to a specific model id.

---

## Additional Tips

- **OpenAI SDK drop-in** — swap `base_url` and `api_key` only; everything else (streaming, tool calling, JSON mode) just works.
- **Pair with OpenRouter for fallback** — if Inference.net runs out of capacity for a specific model, OpenRouter often hosts the same OSS model.
- **Schematron family** is unique to Inference.net — purpose-built for structured/JSON output at very low cost. Worth the $25 just to benchmark against your current GPT-4o-mini structured-output pipeline.
- **Production migration** — combine the $25 with the **OSS Grants Program** for sustained free usage if you're shipping an open-source agent / eval framework.

## Submission 152: IndiaAI Mission - State-Backed AI Startup Funding + Subsidized GPU Pool (38,000+ GPUs)

- Category: Startup Programs
- Source Link: https://indiaai.gov.in/hub/indiaai-startup-financing
- Amount: Subsidised GPU compute (₹65/hr A100, ₹92/hr H100; 40% standard / 100% for selected foundational-model builders) on 38,000+ GPU pool + risk capital via Startup Financing Pillar + access to $1.1B state-backed VC Fund of Funds.
- Difficulty: 4/5 (Hard)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

The **IndiaAI Mission** is a ₹10,371.92 crore (~$1.25 B) Government of India programme run by **MeitY (IndiaAI Independent Business Division)**. It bundles two big things builders care about: (1) heavily **subsidised AI compute** on a national pool of **38,000+ GPUs** at **₹65/hour for A100-class** and **₹92/hour for H100-class** (40% subsidy by default, **100% subsidy for selected foundational-model builders**), and (2) **risk capital** through the IndiaAI Startup Financing pillar plus a separate **$1.1 B state-backed venture capital Fund of Funds** approved by the Cabinet in February 2026 (channelled via SEBI-registered AIFs into deep-tech / AI / advanced manufacturing startups).

This is **India-only**: you need an Indian-registered entity (DPIIT-recognised startup, MSME, or research institution) and Indian KYC (Aadhaar / Digilocker / ePramaan) to even sign in to the compute portal. If you qualify, it is one of the cheapest ways on the planet to train a serious model.

---

## Two Different Things Under One Roof

Don't confuse the two main offerings — they have very different processes:

| Track | What you get | How to apply | Difficulty |
|---|---|---|---|
| **IndiaAI Compute Portal** | Subsidised GPU hours (₹65/hr A100, ₹92/hr H100) | Self-serve portal sign-up + KYC, auto-approval ≤5,000 GPU hours | Easy if Indian |
| **Foundational Model Call for Proposals** | **100% free** compute (no ₹/hr charge) for building Indic LLMs / foundation models | Competitive RFP — select few startups (e.g. Sarvam, Soket, Gnani, Gan, Fractal) | Very hard |
| **Startup Financing Pillar** | Equity / risk capital for deep-tech AI startups | Online application via IndiaAI portal, multi-stage screening | Hard |
| **$1.1 B VC Fund of Funds** | Indirect VC funding (LP into AIFs) | Apply to private AIFs that receive the LP money — not direct from govt | Hard |
| **Global Acceleration Programme** | Soft-landing in Europe via Station F + HEC Paris (10 startups/cohort) | Cohort application | Hard |

---

## Eligibility (the hard line)

- **Indian entity** registered in India is mandatory for everything below.
- **DPIIT-recognised startup**, MSME, registered research institution, academic faculty, or government body.
- For deep-tech startup definition (revised 2026): up to **20 years from incorporation**, turnover up to **₹300 crore**, demonstrable R&D intensity.
- Founders/team need to authenticate via **Meri Pehchaan** (Digilocker / Parichay / ePramaan) — i.e., Indian KYC. Foreign founders without an Indian entity cannot use the compute portal.
- For the foundational model 100% subsidy: only a handful of startups have been selected via formal RFP rounds; not a self-serve track.

If you are a solo international vibe coder, **this is not for you** — look at NVIDIA Inception, Modal credits, or generic startup programs instead.

---

## IndiaAI Compute Portal — Subsidised GPUs (the realistic free-tier-ish track)

This is the part most Indian builders/startups will actually use.

### What's in the pool
- **38,000+ GPUs** already provisioned across **14 empanelled cloud service providers** (Yotta, Tata, Jio, CtrlS, E2E, NxtGen, etc.). Original target was 10,000; over-delivered. Another ~20,000 GPUs being added.
- Mix of **NVIDIA H100, H200, A100, L40S, L4, MI300X**, plus newer GB200 / B200 announced post-AI Impact Summit 2026.

### Pricing (after 40% standard subsidy)
| GPU class | End-user price |
|---|---|
| A100 / equivalent | **₹65 / GPU-hour** (~$0.78) |
| H100 / equivalent | **₹92 / GPU-hour** (~$1.10) |

For reference, on-demand H100 in the US is typically $2.50–$4/hr — so this is roughly 1/3 the global rate.

### Foundational model builders
Selected startups (Sarvam AI, Soket AI Labs, Gnani.ai, Gan.ai, Fractal — list grows each round) receive **100% subsidy** = compute is fully free for the duration of the build. You apply through specific **Call for Proposals** rounds for foundational/sovereign LLM work — not the standard portal flow.

---

## Registration on IndiaAI Compute Portal (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to the **IndiaAI Compute Portal** linked from [indiaai.gov.in/hub/indiaai-compute-capacity](https://indiaai.gov.in/hub/indiaai-compute-capacity).
2. Sign in via **Meri Pehchaan** using one of: **Digilocker**, **Parichay**, or **ePramaan** account (Indian government SSO).
3. Pick your applicant category — **Startup**, **MSME**, **Research / Academic**, **Student**, **IndiaAI Fellowship awardee**, or **Government / PSU**.
4. Fill the **eligibility form** and upload supporting docs (DPIIT certificate for startups, Udyam for MSMEs, institution affiliation letter for research, etc.).
5. Submit a **compute request** specifying GPU type, number, and total GPU-hours needed.
6. **Approval rules:**
   - **≤ 5,000 GPU-hours → auto-approved** (instant or near-instant).
   - **> 5,000 GPU-hours → manual review by the PMEC committee** (Programme Management & Evaluation Committee). Expect days to a couple of weeks.
7. Once approved, you get a **voucher / allocation** redeemable on the empanelled CSP of your choice. Use it like normal cloud GPU time — but billed at the subsidised rate.

**Important:**
- You are paying — just heavily subsidised. This is **not** "free credits" in the way AWS Activate is; you still need a payment method on the empanelled CSP for whatever portion isn't subsidy.
- For foundational-model 100% subsidy, the allocation is granted upfront, no out-of-pocket spend.
- One approved compute request typically has a **time window** (use within the validity, then re-apply).
- Non-Indian payment cards / non-Indian billing addresses won't work on most empanelled CSPs.

---

## Startup Financing Pillar (Equity / Risk Capital)

For deep-tech AI startups looking for **funding** rather than compute. Process:

1. Apply through the **IndiaAI portal** (online only).
2. **Stage 1 — Initial screening:** Eligibility, completeness, quality of proposal.
3. **Stage 2 — Technical evaluation:** Innovation, technical feasibility, responsible AI practices, team quality.
4. **Stage 3 — PoC review & shortlisting:** Demo / proof-of-concept evaluation by expert panel.
5. Selected startups receive funding (size varies per round) plus mentorship and ecosystem support.

### $1.1 B State-Backed VC Fund (Fund of Funds)
Approved by the Indian Cabinet in **February 2026**. This is a **fund-of-funds** — government commits capital to private SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs); those AIFs invest in startups. So you don't apply to the government for this money directly — you raise from one of the participating AIFs (which will be announced as deployment proceeds). Targets AI, deep-tech, advanced manufacturing.

---

## IndiaAI Startups Global Acceleration Programme

Run in partnership with **Station F (Paris)** and **HEC Paris**. Each cohort selects **10 Indian AI startups** for soft-landing into European markets — workspace at Station F, HEC Paris mentorship, EU partner introductions. Apply through periodic open calls announced on the IndiaAI portal.

---

## What This Unlocks vs. Cost

For an Indian-registered AI startup:

- **₹65/hr A100** = roughly **$0.78/hr** vs **~$2/hr** market → ~60% saving over commercial cloud.
- **₹92/hr H100** = roughly **$1.10/hr** vs **~$3–4/hr** market → ~65–70% saving.
- **Foundational model track:** literal $0 compute spend during build — only viable for serious LLM/foundation model teams that can win the RFP.

For 1,000 H100-hours (a realistic small fine-tune):
- Commercial: ~$3,000
- IndiaAI subsidised: ~₹92,000 (~$1,100)
- Foundational model awardee: ₹0

---

## Caveats / Gotchas

- **Indian KYC required.** Aadhaar-linked Digilocker is the smoothest path. Foreign founders cannot self-onboard.
- **Compute is allocated, not gifted.** Auto-approval works for small jobs (<5,000 GPU-hours), but anything bigger goes through committee — plan for delays.
- **Empanelled CSP variability.** GPU availability and exact pricing vary by CSP (Yotta, Jio, Tata, etc.). Check which CSP has your preferred GPU type before requesting.
- **Foundational model 100% subsidy is highly competitive.** ~500+ proposals received in early rounds; only a handful selected. Don't bank on it for your roadmap.
- **The $1.1 B VC fund money is intermediated through private AIFs** — you don't apply to the government for cheques.
- **Programme runs through the Mission's term (notionally 5 years from 2024)**, so timelines / amounts may shift; always check the current portal state.
- **Region lock:** Compute is hosted in Indian data centres — latency-sensitive workloads serving non-India users should account for this.

---

## Difficulty Rank — Why 4

For the **standard compute subsidy track**, getting onto the portal as a DPIIT-recognised Indian startup is fairly mechanical (rank ~3 if you're already registered in India). But the *whole programme as listed* — including the headline foundational-model 100% subsidy and the $1.1 B fund — is gated behind institutional eligibility (Indian entity, formal recognition, competitive proposal review, AIF intermediation). For most readers of a global "free AI credits" list, the practical rank is **4 (Hard)** because of the strict India-only eligibility and competitive nature of the headline benefits.

---

## Additional Tips

- If you only need general AI credits and you're not Indian, look elsewhere (this isn't for you).
- If you **are** an Indian deep-tech founder: get **DPIIT recognition** first — it unlocks IndiaAI, plus SISFS, plus VC partner programmes.
- Combine IndiaAI compute subsidy with **Sarvam AI's startup credits** and **Bhashini** datasets if you're building Indic-language AI.
- Watch IndiaAI's **Call for Proposals** announcements — that's where new tracks (foundational models, applications, safety, datasets) open up periodically.
- The **IndiaAI Innovation Challenge** runs separate funding + government contract opportunities — different application track from the financing pillar.

## Submission 151: HubSpot for Startups - up to 90% off CRM/marketing tools

- Category: Startup Programs
- Source Link: https://www.hubspot.com/startups
- Amount: Up to 90% off year 1, 50% off year 2, 25% off year 3+ on Pro/Enterprise Hubs (top tier) — or 30% / 15% on Bootstrap tier without a partner
- Difficulty: 4/5 (Hard)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**HubSpot for Startups** offers eligible early-stage companies a tapered, multi-year discount on HubSpot's Professional and Enterprise plans across **Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Operations Hub, and Commerce Hub** (plus the underlying Smart CRM and Breeze AI agents). The headline tier is **90% off year 1, 50% off year 2, and 25% off year 3+** — but you only get those numbers if you come in through an approved VC, accelerator, incubator, or partner like **Stripe Atlas**. Apply directly without a partner and you cap out at the **30% / 15%** bootstrap tier.

> **Heads-up on the seed entry:** The original seed listed "30% off year 3." HubSpot's current official site lists **25% off year 3** for the top tier. The 30% figure refers to the **year 1** discount on the lower **Bootstrap** tier (no partner needed).

---

## Discount Tiers (2026)

| Tier | Year 1 | Year 2 | Year 3+ | Who qualifies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Top tier (partner-affiliated)** | **90% off** | **50% off** | **25% off** (ongoing) | Pre-seed / Seed / Series A AND affiliated with an approved partner (VC, accelerator, incubator, Stripe Atlas, HubSpot Solutions Partner) |
| **Bootstrap tier** | **30% off** | **15% off** | — | Bootstrapped or non-partner-affiliated startups that meet revenue/age caps |

Discounts apply to **Professional or Enterprise** tiers only — the free CRM and Starter plans are not eligible (and don't need it). Annual commitment is required to lock in the rate. After year 3 you roll to standard list pricing (or 25% ongoing on the top tier).

---

## Eligibility (Top Tier — 90%)

You need to satisfy **all** of:

1. **Funding stage**: raised **Pre-seed, Seed, or Series A** — not Series B or later. Verified via **Crunchbase** or **Pitchbook**.
2. **Funding ceiling** (commonly enforced): generally **less than ~$2M total equity raised** for the maximum 90% rate (some partners stretch this; HubSpot's hard cap is "not yet Series B").
3. **Company age**: typically **under 2 years old** at the time of application (varies slightly by partner).
4. **Not an existing paying HubSpot customer** on a Professional/Enterprise plan. Free / Starter customers can usually upgrade in.
5. **Partner affiliation**: you must come in through one of HubSpot's **4,000+ approved partners** — a VC fund, accelerator, incubator, entrepreneurial org, or **Stripe Atlas / Stripe Corporate Card** membership. Your investor or accelerator either has a perks portal that grants you a code, or HubSpot can verify your funding round on Crunchbase/Pitchbook.

## Eligibility (Bootstrap Tier — 30%)

For founders without a partner connection, HubSpot runs a separate [Bootstrap Program](https://www.hubspot.com/startups/bootstrap-program). Typical caps:

- Less than **$2M annual revenue**
- Less than **2 years old**
- Not an existing HubSpot Pro/Enterprise customer

Most founders who apply directly through hubspot.com/startups end up here by default — even if they would have qualified for the top tier through a partner they didn't realize they could use.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

### Path A — Through your VC, accelerator, or incubator (best rate)

1. Check your **investor / accelerator's perks portal** (e.g., YC Bookface, Techstars Perks, Antler Perks, Sequoia/a16z portfolio dashboards, Stripe Atlas dashboard).
2. Look for the **HubSpot for Startups** offer and click their dedicated apply link / grab the partner code.
3. Fill out the HubSpot for Startups application — include your **partner code** or upload your **funding/affiliation proof**.
4. A HubSpot for Startups rep usually replies within **3–5 business days** to confirm eligibility and route you to a pricing portal.
5. Sign the **annual contract** (the discount only applies to annual billing).
6. Onboard — choose self-serve resources or paid onboarding (onboarding fees themselves are **not discounted** by default; ask your rep to waive).

### Path B — Stripe Atlas / Stripe Corporate Card members

1. From your **Stripe Atlas dashboard**, open the **Perks** section.
2. Find the **HubSpot for Startups** perk and click apply.
3. You'll be routed to a Stripe-Atlas-specific HubSpot landing page ([hubspot.com/startups/partners/stripe-atlas](https://www.hubspot.com/startups/partners/stripe-atlas)).
4. Submit application — Stripe Atlas confirms your membership automatically. You still need to be **VC/accelerator-backed** to hit the full 90% (per Stripe's own perks page); pure-Atlas founders without backing typically get the bootstrap tier.
5. Same contract / onboarding flow as Path A.

### Path C — Direct application (bootstrap tier only)

1. Go to [hubspot.com/startups](https://www.hubspot.com/startups).
2. Click **Apply** and answer the eligibility questionnaire (revenue, age, funding).
3. If you don't list a partner, expect to be routed to the **30% bootstrap tier**.
4. Sign annual contract and onboard.

**Caveat:** Once you're locked into the bootstrap tier on a contract, switching up to the 90% tier later usually requires re-qualifying at renewal — easier to find a partner code *before* you sign.

Discount applies to all of these on **Professional** or **Enterprise** edition:

| Hub | What it does | Why it matters for startups |
|---|---|---|
| **Smart CRM** | Free baseline CRM (always free) | Underlying contact / deal database — included with everything |
| **Marketing Hub** Pro/Ent | Email automation, landing pages, ABM, campaign analytics, AI content | Replaces 5+ point tools (Mailchimp, Marketo, Unbounce, etc.) |

## Approved Partners (How to Find Out If You Qualify)

HubSpot maintains a public **partner directory** at [hubspot.com/startups/partner-program](https://www.hubspot.com/startups/partner-program). Search by your investor's name. Common partners include:

- **Top-tier VCs**: Sequoia, a16z, Accel, Index Ventures, Bessemer, Lightspeed, NEA, Insight, etc.
- **Accelerators**: Y Combinator, Techstars, 500 Global, Antler, Plug and Play, MassChallenge, Founder Institute
- **Strategic partners**: **Stripe Atlas**, **Stripe Corporate Card**, AWS Activate, Microsoft for Startups, NVIDIA Inception
- **Regional / sector orgs**: WeWork Labs, Endeavor, EO (Entrepreneurs' Organization), local government innovation programs

If your investor isn't listed, it's worth asking them to apply — HubSpot adds new partners regularly and an investor referral generally meets the verification requirement on its own.

## Pricing Reality Check (List vs Discounted, USD)

A realistic year-1 spend at the **90% top tier** for a small team (~5 sales seats, 2,000 marketing contacts):

| Plan | List price (annual) | At 90% off | At 50% off (yr 2) | At 25% off (yr 3) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marketing Hub Professional (2,000 contacts) | ~$10,800 | **~$1,080** | ~$5,400 | ~$8,100 |
| Sales Hub Professional (5 seats) | ~$6,000 | **~$600** | ~$3,000 | ~$4,500 |
| Service Hub Professional (5 seats) | ~$6,000 | **~$600** | ~$3,000 | ~$4,500 |
| **Total annual** | **~$22,800** | **~$2,280** | **~$11,400** | **~$17,100** |

List prices fluctuate; treat the table as order-of-magnitude. Onboarding fees (Marketing Pro: ~$3,000; Sales/Service Pro: ~$1,500 each) are **separate** and only sometimes negotiable down via your rep.

---

## Gotchas

- **Annual contract lock-in.** No month-to-month at the discount. If you cancel mid-year, you still owe the full year.
- **Onboarding fees are usually not waived** by default. Always negotiate them as part of your initial deal — easier to push back at signature than mid-contract.
- **Marketing contact pricing scales fast.** Marketing Hub Pro starts at 2,000 contacts; every additional 1,000 contacts costs more. The 90% discount applies to the **subscription**, but contact-tier upgrades during the year may be billed at less-discounted rates — confirm with your rep.
- **Existing paying HubSpot customers don't qualify.** If you're already on a Pro/Ent plan and want to backfill the discount, you generally can't. Apply *before* you upgrade off Free/Starter.
- **You only get one discount window.** The 3-year tapered discount is once-per-company. If you graduate out and come back later, you're a regular customer.
- **Year 3 = 25%, not 30%.** A common point of confusion (including in the seed entry that triggered this enrichment) — the 30% figure is the *year-1 bootstrap* discount, not year-3 of the top tier.
- **"Through Stripe Atlas" doesn't automatically mean 90%.** Per Stripe's own perks documentation, Atlas members still need to be VC/accelerator-backed to qualify for the maximum tier. Solo Atlas founders typically get the bootstrap rate.

---

## Stripe Atlas Bonus Perks (Worth Knowing)

If you're an Atlas customer applying via that path, HubSpot bundles in:

- **$20,000 in Stripe payment-processing fees waived** on your first $20K of payments (via the [HubSpot x Stripe offer](https://offers.hubspot.com/startups/vestbee/stripe-offer))
- **Discounted Stripe Atlas incorporation** if you incorporate after applying
- **Priority betas** + special event access

These stack with Stripe Atlas's other perks (AWS Activate, Mercury, Carta, etc.).

---

## Additional Tips

- **Get a partner code BEFORE applying** — going in cold from hubspot.com almost always lands you in the 30% bootstrap tier.
- **Ask your rep about "founder pricing" on contacts** — sometimes they'll lock in a higher contact tier at the discounted base price for year 1.
- **Use the [HubSpot for Startups Program Guide](https://offers.hubspot.com/hubspot-for-startups-program-guide)** to surface negotiation levers (free onboarding, extra seats, contact uplifts) before your call.
- **If you're YC-backed**, apply via Bookface — HubSpot has a dedicated YC pipeline that's faster than the public form.
- **If you're EU-based**, the program is identical but billed in EUR/GBP; check VAT handling in the contract.

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [activity.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/free_packages](https://activity.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/free_packages/) and click **"Sign up for free"** (or land on [auth.huaweicloud.com/intl](https://auth.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/) directly).

**Important:**
- The **"Add Card"** button is grayed out for many regions. Online card payment is only enabled for customers contracting with specific Huawei signing entities (Hong Kong, Singapore, Chile, Mexico, Saudi Arabia, Thailand, Philippines, etc.). If you're in an unsupported region, you cannot fully activate the account.
- Each new user can claim **only one** newcomer package. Huawei flags duplicate accounts based on **identical IDs, matching domain holders, shared phone numbers, devices, or IP addresses** — so signing up over a VPN you've used before, or from an office IP that already registered, will be rejected.
- Accounts with **unpaid orders** are blocked from claiming trials.
- After the free package window expires, services **silently switch to pay-as-you-go** rates billed against your card. There is no auto-shutoff. **Set up budget alerts** in Cloud Eye / Billing Center before deploying anything.

- **Not a fit if:** You are an indie hacker / hobbyist with no institutional or competition-track credentials, or you want general-purpose cloud credits (this is not a credit grant — it is a dedicated bare-metal GPU server for a specific project)

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

## API Endpoints (quick reference)

- **Async (file upload):** `POST https://api.gladia.io/v2/pre-recorded/` — pass an audio URL or upload, poll the result endpoint
- **Real-time:** open a WebSocket session via `POST https://api.gladia.io/v2/live` to get a session URL, then stream PCM audio chunks
- Auth header: `x-gladia-key: <YOUR_API_KEY>`
- Full API reference: [docs.gladia.io](https://docs.gladia.io/)

---

## What Happens After 10 Hours

- You **don't** get cut off mid-call without warning if you've added a payment method — it transitions to the paid Starter rate.
- **Without a payment method**, the API will start returning quota errors when you exceed 10 h/month. No surprise charges.
- **Starter pay-as-you-go rates** (post-free-quota):
  - Async transcription: **$0.61 / hour** (Solaria base rate is $0.55/h, Starter is slightly higher)
  - Real-time streaming: **$0.75 / hour**
  - All features (diarization, language detection, code-switching) bundled — no add-on fees
- **Growth tier** (volume): async as low as $0.20/hr, real-time as low as $0.25/hr — only worth it if you're burning through hundreds of hours/month.
- **Enterprise**: custom pricing, unlimited concurrency, zero data retention, dedicated infra.

---

## Compliance & Data Handling

- **GDPR**, **HIPAA**, **AICPA SOC 2 Type 2**, and **ISO 27001** compliant — relevant if you're building for healthcare, finance, or EU-regulated verticals on the free tier already.
- Default behavior may use audio for model improvement on Starter; **Growth and Enterprise** offer automatic opt-out, **Enterprise** adds zero data retention.
- EU-headquartered company (France) — useful if data residency in Europe matters for your customers.

---

## Tips & Gotchas

- **Solaria-1 is the only model on the platform now** — older Whisper-based endpoints have been deprecated. If you're following an outdated tutorial referencing model names like `accurate` / `fast`, ignore it; you don't pick a model anymore.
- **Real-time uses WebSockets, not HTTP streaming** — make sure your hosting environment (e.g. some serverless platforms) supports persistent connections.
- **"10 hours" means audio duration**, not wall-clock time. A 1-hour file processed async still counts as 1 hour.
- **Concurrent request limits** (30 real-time / 25 async) apply on the free tier — fine for a prototype, watch out if you load-test.
- For comparison: **AssemblyAI** gives ~$50 in credits (~238 hours of async STT, no real-time), **Speechmatics** gives 8 h/month, **Deepgram** gives $200 of credits. Gladia's pitch is "all features bundled, no card."
- **No referral / bonus program** is publicly documented — the 10 h/month is what you get.

## Submission 144: EuroHPC AI Factories - free access for academic AI research

- Category: Education & Student
- Source Link: https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/ai-factories-access-modes_en
- Amount: Playground: small entry-level allocation (1-3 months). Fast Lane: up to 50,000 GPU-hours (1-3 months). Large Scale: >50,000 GPU-hours, up to 4,644,864 GPU-h on MareNostrum5 ACC (3-12 months). AI for Science: free allocation, project-dependent.
- Difficulty: 3/5 (Medium)
- Expires At: N/A

### Description

**EuroHPC AI Factories** offer **free access to European supercomputers** (LUMI, Discoverer, MareNostrum5, Leonardo and others) for AI training, fine-tuning, and inference. There are **two tracks**: an **Industrial Innovation track** (Playground / Fast Lane / Large Scale) free for **AI SMEs and startups**, and an **AI for Science and Collaborative Projects** track free for **publicly funded research** (academia, public sector, EU-funded consortia).

No credits or money change hands — you apply through a single EuroHPC portal, get judged on technical fit (not commercial viability or VC backing), and receive a wallclock allocation in **GPU hours** on one EuroHPC system.

---

## Which Track Is For You?

| You are... | Use this track | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| AI startup / SME (any size) testing the platform | **Playground** | Free |
| AI startup / SME with HPC experience, ≤50K GPU-h project | **Fast Lane** | Free |
| AI startup / SME, >50K GPU-h project | **Large Scale** | Free |
| Other industrial user (not AI SME/startup) | Industrial tracks | Pay-per-use |
| University / PhD / postdoc / research institute | **AI for Science & Collaborative Projects** | Free |
| Public-sector organization | **AI for Science & Collaborative Projects** | Free |
| Horizon Europe / Digital Europe consortium | **AI for Science & Collaborative Projects** | Free |

**Important:** Academia and public sector users are **explicitly redirected** to the AI for Science track — they cannot use the industrial Playground/Fast Lane/Large Scale modes.

---

## Industrial Innovation: Playground Access

Entry-level mode for new HPC users — meant for testing and experimentation.

- **GPU hours:** Limited (small allocations, exact cap not published — depends on the hosting AI Factory)
- **Allocation duration:** 1, 2 or 3 months
- **Eligibility (free):** AI SMEs and startups; new / entry-level HPC users
- **Eligibility (paid):** Other industrial users on a pay-per-use basis
- **Decision time:** **~2 working days** (FIFO, no competition)
- **Calls open:** Continuous, no cut-off dates
- **Includes:** Onboarding services and guidance from the hosting AI Factory
- **One system per application**

---

## Industrial Innovation: Fast Lane Access (up to 50,000 GPU hours)

For SMEs/startups already comfortable with HPC who need a real workload-sized allocation.

- **GPU hours:** Up to **50,000 GPU-hours**
- **Allocation duration:** 1, 2 or 3 months (chosen at application)
- **Eligibility (free):** AI SMEs and startups with prior HPC experience
- **Decision time:** **~4 working days** (FIFO)
- **Calls open:** Continuous, no cut-off dates
- **One system per application**
- **Application portal:** [access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/calls/49](https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/calls/49)

---

## Industrial Innovation: Large Scale Access (>50,000 GPU hours)

For production-scale AI training (foundation models, large fine-tunes, big multi-node runs).

- **GPU hours:** **More than 50,000** — upper bound varies per system. For example **MareNostrum5 ACC** allows up to **4,644,864 GPU-hours** per proposal.
- **Allocation duration:** 3, 6 or 12 months
- **Eligibility (free):** AI SMEs and startups for innovation purposes
- **Decision time:** **~10 working days** after a cut-off
- **Calls open:** Rolling with **~24 cut-off dates per year** (roughly every two weeks, all at 10:00 CET)
- **Evaluation:** Technical review + EuroHPC JU peer-review office
- **Currently available systems:** LUMI, Discoverer (Leonardo and MareNostrum5 are temporarily closed in this mode due to high demand — verify on the portal before applying)

---

## AI for Science and Collaborative Projects (academic free tier)

The relevant track for **PhD students, postdocs, faculty, public-sector researchers, and EU-funded project consortia**.

- **What you get:** Free and open compute on EuroHPC AI Factories for AI/ML, foundation models and LLM research
- **Eligibility:** Public and private users **primarily for publicly funded research**, plus industrial users in collaborative projects funded by **Horizon Europe** or the **Digital Europe Programme**
- **Cost:** Free
- **No competitive ranking like classic Regular Access** — the AI Factories track is intended to be lower-friction than EuroHPC's traditional peer-reviewed Extreme/Regular Access
- **Apply via:** [access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu](https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/)

If you have a faculty supervisor and an institutional email, this is the path you want — not Playground/Fast Lane.

---

## What Hardware You Actually Run On

EuroHPC "GPU-hour" allocations resolve to different physical accelerators depending on which AI Factory you choose:

| System | Country | GPU |
|---|---|---|
| **LUMI** (LUMI AI Factory) | Finland | AMD Instinct **MI250X** (LUMI-G partition) |
| **Leonardo** | Italy | NVIDIA **A100** (Booster module) |
| **MareNostrum5 ACC** | Spain | NVIDIA **H100** |
| **Discoverer** | Bulgaria | (CPU + GPU partitions) |
| **Karolina** | Czechia | NVIDIA A100 |
| **MeluXina** | Luxembourg | NVIDIA A100 |
| **Vega** | Slovenia | NVIDIA A100 |
| **Deucalion** | Portugal | NVIDIA H100 |

New AI-Factory–dedicated systems are being procured across the EU; check the AI Factory page for the host you target before submitting.

LUMI-G in particular is **AMD ROCm** (not CUDA) — your stack must work on ROCm (PyTorch ROCm builds, JAX ROCm, etc.). For NVIDIA-only code, target Leonardo, MareNostrum5 or Deucalion.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu](https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/) and create an account (EU Login).
2. Pick the right call:
   - **Industrial Playground** → if you are an AI SME/startup and just want to try it.
   - **Industrial Fast Lane** → if you are an AI SME/startup, comfortable with Slurm/MPI, and need ≤50K GPU-h.
   - **Industrial Large Scale** → if you are an AI SME/startup needing >50K GPU-h.
   - **AI for Science and Collaborative Projects** → if you are academia / public sector / EU-project consortium.
3. Fill the online application form. You will need:
   - Project description (scientific/technical relevance)
   - Resources requested (GPU-hours, storage, target system)
   - Team/PI info and institution
   - For industrial tracks: SME/startup status documentation
4. Choose **one** target AI Factory / system per application.
5. Submit. Decisions arrive in **2 working days (Playground)**, **4 working days (Fast Lane)**, or **10 working days after the next cut-off (Large Scale)**.
6. On approval, you get accounts on the chosen system, a project ID, and a quota measured in GPU-hours. Standard SSH + Slurm workflow.

---

## Eligibility Gotchas

- **Academia cannot use Industrial Playground / Fast Lane / Large Scale.** EuroHPC explicitly redirects academic and public-sector users to AI for Science. Do not apply to the wrong track — it will be rejected.
- **"AI SME / startup" is verified.** The free industrial tracks check that you are actually an SME (EU SME definition: <250 employees, ≤€50M turnover) and that AI is your core activity.
- **One system per application.** You cannot mix LUMI + MareNostrum5 in one allocation — submit two applications if you need both.
- **Leonardo and MareNostrum5 may be closed** for new Large Scale allocations during high-demand periods. Check the call page before writing the proposal.
- **GPU-hours are wallclock × #GPUs**, not node-hours. A LUMI-G node has 4× MI250X (8 GCDs) — burning a full node for 1 hour costs 8 GPU-hours by EuroHPC accounting on LUMI.
- **No credit card, no payment** — but also no on-demand spin-up. You wait for an allocation decision before you can run anything.
- **Storage is included** but limited; large datasets may need a separate data-transfer plan.

---

## Compared to Other Free Compute

- vs **AWS / Azure free credits**: EuroHPC is not on-demand — you wait days for approval — but allocations are *much* larger and don't burn against a credit card.
- vs **NAIRR (US)**: similar model (publicly funded HPC for researchers) but EuroHPC also has a real free industrial path for SMEs/startups, which NAIRR doesn't.
- vs **LUMI's national/consortium quotas**: applying via your country's national allocation can be faster if you're already at a partner institution, but EuroHPC AI Factories opens LUMI to non-consortium users.

---

## Additional Tips

- **Start with Playground** if it's your first EuroHPC application — onboarding is included and decisions are 2 days, so you can validate your code on real hardware before writing a Fast Lane / Large Scale proposal.
- **Write Large Scale proposals around the cut-off calendar.** Submitting the day after a cut-off means waiting 2 weeks + 10 working days for a decision.
- **LUMI AI Factory** has its own community docs and training events — useful even before your allocation lands.
- For pure model inference / quick experiments, EuroHPC is overkill — use Cerebras / Groq / OpenRouter free tiers instead and save EuroHPC for training runs.
- Consult the [AI Factories helpdesk](https://eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/ai-factories/helpdesk-ai-factories_en) before submitting a Large Scale proposal — they will tell you whether your target system has capacity.

## OpenAI-Compatibility Cheat Sheet

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="<DEEPINFRA_API_KEY>",
    base_url="https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai",
)

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hello"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

No SDK changes needed beyond the `base_url` swap.

## Tier Assignment (How Much Will I Get?)

## Program Duration & What Happens After

The program ends at the **earliest** of these events:

1. **12 months after Activation** (the standard cap)
2. **Credit exhaustion** — once you burn through your $30K-$100K

4. **Next funding round** — raising your next round (Series B, etc.) ends the program early per Datadog's marketing copy

After the program ends, you're **billed at Datadog's standard pricing** under the MSA. No auto-discount continues, so plan your migration / spend ramp before the 12-month mark.

**Important:**
- The free tier (no card) does **not** qualify — you must be on the **paid** Starter plan with billing enabled.
- The 30% discount is applied to **usage-based fees only** (function calls, storage, bandwidth) — capped at **$30K of cumulative savings**, not $30K of usage.
- Once you exceed $30K in savings or 12 months elapse, you transition to standard Pro pricing.

## What You Actually Get

### Convex Professional plan (free for up to 1 year, normally $25/dev/month)
- **No seat fees** for up to 20 developers (saves up to $6,000/year for a 20-dev team)

- **Email support**
- **Management API**

### 30% off usage-based overages (capped at $30K savings)
Applied to function calls beyond 25M ($2/M normally), database storage beyond 50 GB ($0.20/GB), and file storage beyond 100 GB ($0.03/GB).

### Community & access perks
- **Startup town halls** — periodic events for program members

---

## What Convex Is (and Why You'd Care)

Convex is a TypeScript-first reactive backend platform. One product replaces a typical stack of:

- **Database** (Postgres-like document store with full ACID transactions)
- **Backend functions** (queries / mutations / actions in TypeScript, no API layer to write)
- **Realtime sync** (subscriptions push updates to React/Next/RN clients automatically)
- **File storage** (S3-like, with first-class auth)
- **Scheduled jobs & cron**
- **Full-text + vector search** (built-in, useful for RAG / AI agents)
- **AI Agent components** (workflows, durable actions for LLM apps)

It is particularly popular with AI app startups because it makes building stateful agent apps with persistent memory + realtime UI updates dramatically less plumbing than DIY Postgres + Redis + WebSockets + Pinecone.

---

## Catches & Gotchas

- **Not free credits, it's a discount.** The headline "$30,000" is *savings* (30% off usage), not credit balance. Your real bill still grows with usage; it's just 30% smaller.
- **You must already be paying.** The free tier (no card) does not count. You'll likely pay at least Starter-tier overages while waiting for review.
- **30% discount + waived seats = real money only at scale.** A solo dev with a small app saves maybe $25/mo on seats + a few dollars on usage. A 10-dev team pushing real production load saves several thousand/month.
- **12 months counts from approval**, not from signup.
- **No automatic renewal** — when the year ends or you raise past $3M, you transition to standard Pro pricing. Set a calendar reminder.
- **Approval is not guaranteed** — borderline applications (e.g., $2.9M raised, 19 employees) may still be rejected at Convex's discretion.

- **YC companies** — if you're in YC, ask your group partner; YC perks page typically has Convex offers stacked with this program.

## Where ClickHouse Wins (and where it doesn't)

**Use it for:**
- Product analytics & event tracking (replacing/augmenting Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog at scale)
- Logs / observability (alternative to Datadog logs, Loki at high volume)
- Real-time dashboards over billions of rows
- Data warehousing for AI/LLM telemetry (token counts, latencies, prompts) — this is exactly why Anthropic and OpenAI use it

**Don't use it for:**
- Transactional workloads (it's OLAP, not OLTP — use Postgres/Neon for those)
- Tiny datasets (<10M rows) where Postgres is simpler and free
- Use cases that need frequent row-level updates / deletes

- **Combine with related offers**: many YC startups also stack [Neon's $100K credits](https://neon.com/startups), [Datadog $30-100K](https://www.datadoghq.com/partner/datadog-for-startups/), and [PostHog $50K](https://posthog.com/startups). ClickHouse + Neon + PostHog is a popular YC AI-startup data stack.
- **Watch for ClickHouse OSS** — if you outgrow the cloud credits, the open-source database is fully free and runs on any GPU/CPU box. Migration path is straightforward (same SQL dialect).
- **Limited Access models** — the $10K credit applies to all ClickHouse Cloud features; there are no gated features that require additional approval beyond what's in the standard product.

New accounts receive **$250 in free credit** that can be spent across any billable Civo service. The credit is generous on paper but **short-lived**: it expires at the end of the month *following* the month it is issued, so timing your signup matters more than at most other clouds.

---

## Registration (Step-by-Step)

1. Go to [dashboard.civo.com/signup](https://dashboard.civo.com/signup).
2. Fill in **first name, last name, email, password** and submit. No credit card is requested at this step.
3. Confirm your email via the verification link Civo sends.
4. Sign in to the Civo dashboard.
5. Add a **valid credit/debit card** under **Billing**. The card is required to release the credit; it is not charged while credit remains.
6. Once the card is on file, the **$250 promotional credit** is applied to your account and you can start launching clusters, VMs, etc.

**Important caveats:**
- **Add a card within 21 days of signup** to claim the credit (the wider "3 months to add a card" mentioned in older marketing copy refers to keeping the account alive, not to the credit window — the docs/FAQ now state 21 days).
- Credit is **non-transferable** and cannot be cashed out.
- **One account per person/company.** Civo's fair-use language allows them to deny credit on duplicate accounts.
- After credit is exhausted or expires, **billing automatically continues against your card** — there is no spend cap by default. Set a **billing alert** in the dashboard immediately after signup.

---

## Credit Expiry — Read This Twice

The credit window is unusually short, so plan your spend before you click "Create cluster":

| Credit issued on | Credit valid until |
|---|---|
| 15 May 2026 | 30 June 2026 |
| 1 June 2026 | 31 July 2026 |
| 27 September 2026 | 31 October 2026 |

**Practical takeaway:** sign up and add your card on the **1st of the month** to get close to the maximum ~60 days of usage. Signing up on the 28th gives you barely a month before unused credit evaporates.

Any billable usage is debited from credit first; only once credit runs out (or expires) does Civo charge your card.

GPU instances are also available (NVIDIA A100/H100/H200 in LON1) and burn through $250 quickly — useful for short experiments only.

## Referral Program — 5M Bonus Tokens (Stacks with Student Discount)

Bolt's referral program is **separate** from the education discount and **stacks on top** of it. You can claim it the moment you go Pro.

1. Open Bolt → **Settings → Referrals** → copy your unique link.

3. If that friend **upgrades to a paid plan within 30 days** → **both of you get an additional 5,000,000 bonus tokens** (the headline reward).
   - **Catch:** the 5M Pro-upgrade bonus only triggers if **you (the referrer) are also on a paid plan**. Free-tier users get only the 200K bonus.

**Stacking strategy for students:** verify via SheerID first → upgrade to Pro at $12.50/mo → then refer 1–2 friends → if they go Pro, you've effectively earned **10M+ bonus tokens for $12.50** — that's months of building.
